items.name: Pink Piwi Belt

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.
items.name: Red Piwi Hat

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.
items.name: Blue Piwi Hat

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.
items.name: Purple Piwi Hat

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.
items.name: Yellow Piwi Hat

items.description: Some people might think you look ridiculous wearing this hat, others will find you adorable. That's life.
items.name: Green Piwi Hat

items.description: With this hat on, you'll look ridiculous but you'll be just adorable. Life is a matter of choices.
items.name: Pink Piwi Hat

items.description: This amulet is often mistaken for a lucky-bag gift... It's actually something you win at the shooting range.
items.name: Sponge Amulet

items.description: Offered as a wedding ring, this ring sends two subliminal messages to the wearer: "I love you" and "Go do the dishes". Perfect for those who hate wasting their time repeating the same things over and over again.
items.name: Sponge Ring

items.description: Many inexperienced adventurers will remember this terribly powerful weapon, used as a defence against sods of earth. If you wet it, it becomes soft and can be rolled about, though it generally takes at least two weaklings like yourself to manage it.
items.name: Sponge Shovel

items.description: With these boots, Eniripsas can walk on water... which is quite useless since they can fly anyway, but it always impresses the crowds. Normal folk can always use these boots to exfoliate their feet while they sit around the house.
items.name: Sponge Boots

items.description: This belt allowed Vald to take his seasonal bath without putting his life in danger. Indeed, no Iop ever succeeded in learning so much as the doggy paddle.
items.name: Sponge Belt

items.description: This cape is perfect for camouflaging yourself in the natural environment. Well, it's more like you'll be adding a pleasant touch to the countryside, but hey, who wants to be invisible anyway?
items.name: Sponge Cape

items.description: Instructions: "Offer this helmet to your husband. Firmly attach it to his head and drag him by his feet around your kitchen. You now have a clean, shining floor. Be careful not to drown him when rinsing the helmet off." This sums up the state of the modern marriage. Bloody feminists.
items.name: Sponge Helmet

items.description: This headband will make Iops more handsome than ever!
items.name: Kaliptus Headband

items.description: The Amoolet holds a strange substance that is only found in the guts of a Moowolf. Some say it's the monster's essence, others say it's just the semi-digested remains of a Kirball.
items.name: Amoolet

items.description: Beware! This ring will make your finger stink, although the foul smell may cover a worse odour. Actually, that might be the best thing that could happen to your finger, your hands, and the people around you, to be honest.
items.name: Moowolf Ring

items.description: Ubiquitous boots that are still driven by the voracious appetite of the Moowolf. If your feet smell of Clakoss, these boots will probably bite them.
items.name: Moowolf Boots

items.description: The Moowolf's beautiful, fluffy tail is so long that it trails on the ground. Driven into a jealous rage, some adventurers pulled it off and they now wear it to increase fertility.
items.name: Moowolf Cloak

items.description: This coloured belt has a wonderful purple tuft on the front and if you wear it back to front you can pretend to be a Wabbit.
items.name: Moowolf Belt

items.description: While dismembering the Moowolf, hunters discovered that it only has one big horn going right through its skull. That doesn't seem to bother Iops, who wear it proudly anyway.
items.name: Moowolf Headgear

items.description: This necklace protected the Minotoror from getting fleas, ticks and even lice. You can be the judge of whether you need it or not.
items.name: Minotoror Necklace

items.description: Unlike what some adventurers may think, this ring was never worn by the Minotoror who was unable to fit such a delicate thing around his hoofs.
items.name: Minotoror Ring

items.description: This bracelet fully protects the arm of an Eniripsa, but triples its weight.
items.name: Minotot Bracelet

items.description: This ring of leather and ivory makes it easier for you to stimulate your partner.
items.name: Dragon Pig Ring

items.description: This necklace protects the Minotot's cervical vertebrae from lethal Wabbit punches.
items.name: Minotot Necklace

items.description: This necklace comes with a small loop so the owner of the Dragon Pig can attach a leash to it. It also does wonders for Dragon Pig lice.
items.name: Dragon Pig Necklace

items.description: This very axe actually beheaded one of the most dangerous Minotorors in the province of Amakna. What I can't believe is that you don't seem to care!
items.name: Minotoror Axe

items.description: This sceptre with a Plissken head made of precious stones at one end enables you to scare away young adventurers and kick their pinky butts.
items.name: Minotot Sceptre

items.description: You won't go winning the legendary race of Amakna Bay with these terrible boots of Minotoror Hair and leather. You might manage to break the competitors' toes on the starting line, though.
items.name: Minotoror Boots

items.description: These incredible sandals will enable you to bathe in the most dangerous waters without hurting your feet. Be careful however, as they're said to scratch the bottom of bathtubs.
items.name: Minotot Sandals

items.description: A good pair of mules at your side and you'll feel stronger, more powerful and deadlier than ever. They're just ordinary mules, though. It must be the vibes they give off.
items.name: Dragon Pig Mules

items.description: Take a Minotoror. Firmly tie him up. Take a giant plane and peel off his back in a oner. There! You've got your Minotoror Cloak!
items.name: Minotoror Cloak

items.description: This is the perfect cloak to go out or practise your seduction skills at the Captain Chafer's masked ball.
items.name: Minotot Cloak

items.description: This cloak will not turn you into a Piglet but at least you'll be able dress up for one night and seduce a beautiful sow.
items.name: Dragon Pig Cloak

items.description: This supple belt can be used to whip unruly kids' bottoms. Its buckle might even mark their skin but this would only teach them their lesson once and for all.
items.name: Minotoror Belt

items.description: The Minotot used this stiff belt to hold his huge potbelly in, preventing him from toppling over every time he felt a draught.
items.name: Minotot Belt

items.description: This headgear has been passed down from generation to generation through the Minotot family. This partially explains why it smells like rotting dandruff.
items.name: Minotot Headgear

items.description: With this huge skull on, you'll look like a stiff-bristled Grizball, but with no hair. Your admirers will be speechless.
items.name: Dragon Pig Headgear

items.description: According to the legend, this scale-covered cape will protect you from lightning, beans and femmes fatales, whatever they are.
items.name: Dreggon Cape

items.description: A little angel like you could easily pass for a merciless warrior with such a terrifying and disproportionate helmet on. If that doesn't work, it'll make a great cloak rack.
items.name: Dreggon Helmet

items.description: The most perverted minds in Amakna say that this belt can be used as a prosthesis. No one knows why they would say that, though, and they're wrong. It's just a plain old Dreggon belt. Really.
items.name: Dreggon Belt

items.description: This ring, directly cut in the shape of a giant Dreggon scale, will protect a small part of your phalanx. Maybe the most important part...
items.name: Dreggon Ring

items.description: Made of Dreggon scales, this amulet will efficiently protect your Adam's Api or your tonsils. It will make all the difference on a battlefield.
items.name: Dreggon Amulet

items.description: These boots are perfect for killing Gobballs while playing Gobbowl or making your enemies suffer some more during spanking sessions.
items.name: Dreggon Boots

items.description: You'll end up without a nose if you use this sword to shave your face. Save it for your back.
items.name: Dreggon Sword

items.description: This axe cuts through skulls like a hot knife through butter.
items.name: Dreggon Axe

items.description: Heavier than an empty Munchor Skull, but less solid than a Cave-dwelling Kirball femur, this hammer is nevertheless quite a fearsome weapon.
items.name: Dreggon Hammer

items.description: This bow is so powerful that it can send Dreggon eggs over the great wall of Brakmar. What a wonderful waste of food!
items.name: Dreggon Bow

items.description: This wand seems to be a lot more effective when it's used as a club or as a Moskito swatter!
items.name: Dreggon Wand

items.description: One end of this staff is armed with a long, sharp point. No one knows where it came from, but you can guess where it usually goes.
items.name: Dreggon Staff

items.description: Shika used to help Farle at harvest time by picking up the magic grain his scythe swiped. She used it to make necklaces. Though their roots and stalks have been cut off, these magic ears keep on ripening every year around the same time.
items.name: Shika's Ears

items.description: This bracelet covered up Shika's arms. This way it protected her from sunburn and Crobak pecks... the little creatures were attracted by her stunning beauty and many claim to have gotten lucky with her.
items.name: Shika's Magic Bracelet

items.description: This custom-made hoe helped Shika make the highest haystacks in the realm. Legend has it they were so big that sailors used them as markers to tell how far they were from the Amaknian coast.
items.name: Shika's Hoe

items.description: These clogs were created for Shika so that she wouldn't trample the seedbeds of the Snossios plains. The high-heels make it easier to run in the stubble without hurting her ankles and stop the dew getting in.
items.name: Shika's Clogs

items.description: Flowers from harvest time have been sewn to this cape made of woven magic cereals. It's driven by such a powerful magic that Shika used to use it for protection against lightning on stormy nights!
items.name: Shika's Cape

items.description: This belt of leather used to protect Shika's thighs when she ran across the wheat fields to bring back to their herd lost Gobballs. Covered with pollen from magic cereals, legend says that it used to shimmer in the moonlight and ensured Farle didn't cut his wife's legs while reaping fields of cereals at night.
items.name: Shika's Belt

items.description: Covered with a multitude of flowers, this hat made Shika look happy and bright when she left at the crack of dawn to plough the Church Hills.
items.name: Shika's Hat

items.description: If you want to protect your pretty face from the ravages of time, we suggest this headgear. It makes a great adult nappy too.
items.name: Mumminotor Headgear

items.description: This little headgear lets Dragandrops throw themselves at their enemies without running the risk of getting lumps on their foreheads. It's long been in use on major construction sites in Amakna, as well. This headgear became all the rage again after Moowolves from Kruup Mountain invaded Astrub. What's the point of this story? There is no point, but who cares?
items.name: Dragandrop Headgear

items.description: With this hat on, you'll be able to dress up and seduce any naive Astrubian you find... Just offer him a hot date for 100 kamas, and Bob's your uncle, his wallet's empty.
items.name: Dragostess Hat

items.description: This mysterious cape only comes out once a year, but the scammers always use it to get a fast kama from the kiddies.
items.name: Father Kwismas Cape

items.description: This hat will hide the scars all over your head. That way, no more toddlers will be injured trying to flee in terror from your Santa stall.
items.name: Father Kwismas Hat

items.description: This strange sword sure won't make you invincible... In fact, people have died trying to kill snowmen with it.
items.name: Kwismas Sword

items.description: These boots smell of Pineapi juice marinated with wet socks. The great thing is that when you visit your friends, they will never ask you to take your shoes off.
items.name: Pineapi Boots

items.description: This cape used to belong to a famous capon, a long-feathered bird that loved to dance near the Bonta Zaap and puff itself up in front of all the gullible poultry and immature chickens.
items.name: Little Red Waddling Cape

items.description: This cursed pendant is wrapped in bandages and might help you survive the Labyrinth of the Minotoror's curse. But there's no guarantee – it may just be a trinket meant to captivate tourists.
items.name: Mumminotor Pendant

items.description: This ugly, stench-ridden ring is made out of Mumminotor bandages. It makes a great Band Aid when you catch your finger in one of the doors of the Labyrinth of the Minotoror - possibly the least of all your worries, but a comfort nonetheless.
items.name: Mumminotor Wedding Ring

items.description: The rock at the end of this hammer is rolled in absorbent Mumminotor bandages for those home-based assassinations.
items.name: Mumminotor Hammer

items.description: These daggers are perfect for cutting the top off a soft-boiled Dreggon egg. They're also very light, which enables you to run fast when the Dreggon community realises what you've done.
items.name: Dreggon Daggers

items.description: Padded and decorated with Mumminotor bandages, these boots are comfy and warm. They might even remind you of long-forgotten mother-cuddles.
items.name: Mumminotor Boots

items.description: Made from plaited Mumminotor bandages, this cape will give you a slow, sad, undead look. You'll be the envy of the town.
items.name: Mumminotor Cape

items.description: This small shovel was once given to a young Enutrof. He liked it so much that he took up digging full time. He dug his own grave when he was twenty eight and healthy... dug himself a whole graveyard, he still didn't die. His body was lost at sea first time he left home. How ironic.
items.name: Cake Shovel

items.description: The origin of this large Mumminotor bandage is unknown. Its use is even more mysterious, since it actually speeds up decomposition. Great for an Aprirel Fool's Day trick. Just make sure you keep a list of all the good friends you give it to so you can tell them to take it off again.
items.name: Mumminotor Belt

items.description: Captain Mayhav is said to have used this very shovel to rip open the Great White Kralove known as Dopy Mick.
items.name: Shovel Ijah

items.description: Dreggons like to dig networks of underground passages but they never use these shovels. The Enutrof community studied this enigma but concluded that it was less important to know where they came from than how to hit someone with one.
items.name: Dreggon Shovel

items.description: Bill wanted a halo. He screamed so loud and threw such a tantrum that he finally got it. A real little devil.
items.name: Billalo

items.description: Brouce Boulgoure used this mask to discreetly infiltrate a Grossewer rats' den and cut down an elm by the roots. On the way out, he squashed every single rat in the den with his wooden clogs.
items.name: Black Rat Mask

items.description: This cape can be made with any sort of animal hair provided that it's very dirty. They are plaited together and then cemented with various secretions. The smell is unfortunately not optional.
items.name: Black Rat Cape

items.description: Badly damaged, but extremely sharp, these dagger blades will slice off a limb with disconcerting ease. They'll sink through bones like butter, allowing you to carve your enemies up like spring chickens. What a pity they aren't rusty, poisoned and white-hot too!
items.name: Black Rat Daggers

items.description: The rat who used to own this necklace thought he would become the chief of his clan. He was devoured by a rabid Lenald.
items.name: Black Rat Necklace

items.description: Be careful when you put on these boots, as there might still be a foot or two of the previous owner inside them.
items.name: Black Rat Boots

items.description: Unlike his Bontarian cousin, the Black rat is discreet and wears a simple fabric belt. But he also likes to take a lot of weapons with him, and it all makes a terrible clinking noise at each of his steps.
items.name: Black Rat Belt

items.description: They say that the Black Rat himself scratched his own back with the sharp claws on this glove. Be that as it may, it may still have fur and hair caught in the crevices and there are no guarantees as to the odour. One could even wonder if he only scratched his back...
items.name: Black Rat Glove

items.description: This weapon is the symbol of the White Rat. It will slice both enemies and allies with the same ease.
items.name: White Rat Rapier

items.description: With this hat, the White Rat looks like a real musketeer from Bonta. Without this hat, he looks like an ordinary, hatless white rat from Bonta.
items.name: White Rat Hat

items.description: This cape is the identifying symbol of white rats throughout the Bonta sewers. It is the reward a rat gets after a long and difficult series of examinations and is proudly worn until the pants his final ratty breath... which usually isn't very long at all.
items.name: White Rat Cape

items.description: If you wear this around your neck like a necklace, it'll protect you from the toxic sewer fumes. If you wear it lower down like a belt, it will protect your allies from your toxic intestinal fumes.
items.name: White Rat Necklace

items.description: This glove used to belong to Julia Dilch, master cook at the Bonta palace. She used it to knock out gobballs that didn't want their throats slit, wild plants that didn't want to end up in a salad bowl, and clients reluctant to eat what was on the menu. And through it all, she stayed classy, never once getting her hands dirty.
items.name: White Rat Glove

items.description: Although their Brakmarian cousins may not agree, white rats like to be as discreet as possible. That's why this belt is so light and small – to stylishly offset overly imposing bodies.
items.name: White Rat Belt

items.description: With these boots, your balance will be perfect. You won't sway in the slightest, even on the windiest of days.
items.name: White Rat Boots

items.description: This hat has nothing to do with a Dora, a Brave's Dark Dora, a Dora Bora or a Doro L. Blak. Absolutely nothing! So don't bother spreading rumours about its designer being slack or uninspired! It's just a very nice looking hat.
items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Hat

items.description: This colourful cape turns you into an ideal target. Only quick and nimble adventurers can wear it for more than a few minutes.
items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Cape

items.description: To dissuade greedy thieves, this necklace is secured around the neck of the heir to the Lord of the Rats at his birth. The only way to remove it is to take off his head... This doesn't seem to dissuade the thieves.
items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Necklace

items.description: This ring was designed at a time when the Lord of the Rats only had one finger left after mutilating all the others. The unfortunate lords that followed had all of theirs.
items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Ring

items.description: The patterns on this belt will have people thinking you're on fire. The optical illusion is so powerful that you shouldn't be surprised when complete strangers throw water all over you. Amazingly enough, this corresponds exactly to the ceremonial ritual.
items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Belt

items.description: The very first Lord of the Rats died when he stepped in a pool of molten lava. To pay tribute to him, his lords wear these boots. By the way, they are not in the least bit fireproof.
items.name: Lord of the Rats' Ceremonial Boots

items.description: The mushrooms pushing up on this helmet spread a nice exhilarating smell that makes you want to take roots. They are also quite tasty but might definitely bury you.
items.name: Ancestral Treechelmet

items.description: In summer, the Ancestral Treechnid likes to sunbathe but as its wood is accustomed to dark forests, it doesn't stand it very well. This cape is made of his bark peelings.
items.name: Ancestral Treecape

items.description: Worn around your neck with a low-cut top, this torc will accentuate your beard beautifully. If you don't have one... well... you only have yourself to blame.
items.name: Ancestral Torc

items.description: If you've had a little too much to drink, you might see the Moskito embedded in this ring wink at you. But don't tell your friends, the little beast will deny everything.
items.name: Ancestral Ring

items.description: Your legs will fear nothing when you're wearing these solid wood shin guards. Unfortunately, you can't wear them and boots at the same time. You can wear them for protection during gobbowl ball games, but your toes will take the full brunt of any toe pokers.
items.name: Ancestral Shin Guards

items.description: This belt is supposed to inspire you with ancestral virility. Whether this was ever true or not, the effect has now surely gone without a trace.
items.name: Ancestral Treebelt

items.description: This piece of wood extracted from the very heart of the Soft Oak is extremely powerful. Indeed, it can even enrage the Soft Oak.
items.name: Soft Oak Talisman

items.description: This ring is made of Soft Oak faeces. It's wooden alright, but the smell remains the same.
items.name: Soft Oak Ring

items.description: On Sundays, the Soft Oak takes a long nap and when he wakes up he likes to have an obedient Trunknid bring him his flip-flops. Fortunately, he doesn't have any feet so they're still brand new.
items.name: Soft Oak Flip-Flops

items.description: More than 200 years ago, some fabric got stuck in the Soft Oak's branches. As the tree grew, it imbued the fabric with its magic. The cloth is now an integral part of this huge piece of wood and though it makes it hard to handle and highly flammable, its power can't be denied.
items.name: Worn Soft Oak Cape

items.description: In autumn, the Soft Oak wears its G-string to protect his precious acorns. In summer time, he likes to go commando.
items.name: Autumnal Soft Oak G-String

items.description: No matter how you wear this hat, it will always look like it's on sideways.
items.name: Soft Oak Hat

items.description: There's nothing better for collecting "bits" of creatures than Bworknroll's scalpel, which preserves the vitality of the torn-off limbs.
items.name: Bworknroll's Scalpel

items.description: The red cape is the favourite artefact of megalomaniacs. Once on their frail shoulders, they believe they are Superman or an ultra-powerful magician. Until they meet a Minotoror at least.
items.name: The Red Cape

items.description: These Goblin skin boots were created by Planbworksek to charge the enemy (if possible from behind) extremely quickly. These boots saved many a Bwork comrade in wartime.
items.name: Gobtrotter

items.description: This hat keeps your ears warm and absorbs the alcohol on your breath. What else could you ask for?
items.name: Ruskie Hat

items.description: The Flud is not really a hat. It's more of a parasite that tends to develop on loud or aggressive people's heads. Its disgusting appearance repels all and sundry, compelling its wearer to scream even louder which is useless since these people have nothing to say anyway.
items.name: Flud

items.description: This padded cape absorbs all surrounding noise, plunging the wearer into a lifetime of incredibly awkward silences.
items.name: S'loque Cape

items.description: These getas are so light that they make their owner run and jump all over the place whenever some action starts. Experienced adventurers just hate them... Every Tom Dick and Harry comes and crashes their fights uninvited.
items.name: Crashers

items.description: This belt must be worn tight... so tight that it forces its wearer to stammer, shake and generally jerk around in the inimitable style of Thrustin Timbertake.
items.name: Muffin Belt

items.description: This small ring has no use beside making you look extremely flashy. Now people might actually want to talk to you.
items.name: Pluswan

items.description: After several nights of hard work, the most famous jeweller in Astrub, also known for being raised by Bworks, announced to an astounded crowd: "c u l8r @ d gld hs". Even the renowned historian Champo Lhyon didn't manage to decipher the jeweller's message.
items.name: Issa Mess

items.description: This cute Pandawa Cub will gladly travel round the World with you and discover its mysteries with its big, round eyes.
items.name: Pandawa Cub

items.description: This cap used to belong to a little Xelorette who got a kick out of disrupting the passage of time. Legend has it that she once stole several days off the inhabitants of Amakna. She had to hand out quite a few candies to make up for that little trick.
items.name: Doro L. Blak

items.description: A famous Feca warrior who lived in the jungle of Pandala was often heard to say: "To win the war, you have to become the war".
items.name: First Blood Staff

items.description: This sharp sword gained this elegant crimson colour after gutting thousands of Bworks. Before, it was just purplish.
items.name: Crimson Claw

items.description: These blades have holes all over them so that they make a nice little whistling noise when handled quickly. The holes are also extremely useful when it comes to gutting your enemies.
items.name: Emment Daggers

items.description: These daggers were forged for a Ecaflip who had a real thing for proper manicures. She thought that heavy swords that didn't match her perfectly varnished claws.
items.name: Clawettes

items.description: This shiny sword is perfect for trimming flowers and trees, even if the plants fight back.
items.name: Stalk Sword

items.description: This blade has been lubricated to slip into its sheath more easily. However, it cannot be cleaned after use and must be thrown away, especially if it's covered in blood. Bear in mind that its main use is to protect you.
items.name: Rubber Sword

items.description: It's a big staff with nails knocked into it. Do not hope for something else in this staff, it's simple and loosens your enemies' teeth nicely.
items.name: Studded Staff

items.description: Rumour has it that a Sadida named Fraye used this staff to protect his wife and son from an enraged flock of Gobballs. What a pity that he also mistook his family for the monsters during the fight.
items.name: Scrap Staff

items.description: This bow is light, delicate, elegant and smells of cherry tree flowers. It is also lethal if used for anything other than striking a pose.
items.name: Bushi'Bow

items.description: If you hold this bow high and joyfully say "Pampulilu!", you'll look absolutely ridiculous.
items.name: Bow Liwood

items.description: This wand belongs to a famous Grinegau who makes excellent coffee, but who just can't get the ladies.
items.name: Wand Else?

items.description: With the Bidjiz, you'll stay alive probably because your opponents will start dancing when they see the disco ball at the end of this wand.
items.name: The Bidjiz

items.description: Created like a Smithmagic masterpiece, this shovel digs really bad, except when it's your opponents' heads.
items.name: Shovel Minster

items.description: This shovel is a great invention. It can dig up a grave and be left on top as a cross, provided only one adventure fellow dies at the time... Or else you'll have to dig the other graves with your hands.
items.name: RIP Shovel

items.description: This Hammer easily crushes skulls to pulp... which is exactly why it's tinted with a nice red tomato colour.
items.name: Red Hammer

items.description: This hammer was created during the reign of King Stephan, a terrible tyrant who terrorised trillions of people.
items.name: Stephammer

items.description: Your pet, our passion.
items.name: Purrin Axe

items.description: This strange axe is designed to easily behead Bworks. The ease with which it can also behead Astrub's inhabitants clearly indicates that there's a connection between these two populations. But no one has discovered just what it is yet.
items.name: Koss Axe

items.description: Thanks to this warrior hat, Iops really cut a fine figure. The only problem is that it hides some of their field of vision and prevents them from hearing their opponents' words. This hat is designed for those who like to strike before they think.
items.name: Hat Ariutokinabot

items.description: Colleague and friend of the famous Guy-Guy (close relative of the Soft Oak), Sarr Ys is a minstrel whose enchanting melodies have been engraved in Amakna's collective unconscious. Unfortunately, this brilliant artist had a tragic Quaquack accident after a particularly boozy New Year's Eve celebration.
items.name: Sarr Ys's Flute

items.description: This headgear bestows self confidence and temerity on whoever wears it. Thanks to it you'll always keep going thinking you can actually make exploits. Remember to take it off from time to time or it will take you into inextricable situations!

effects.formatted: Heads or Tails: +1 cast(s) per target

items.name: Ukando Hat

items.description: Every time an opponent comes to face this headgear, he turns as silent as the grave. No one dares ask what it is supposed to be. But that's ok, Srams aren't known for their sensitivity.
items.name: Hat Tsokey

items.description: This hat looks like the Sulik and the Paperb' Hat. But since it's very comfy and Xelors never take it off - even when they sleep, it is commonly called Hatter Lily. It gives off a nice pleasant white water lily smell which helps you get to sleep. However, it also provokes snores as unbearable as the Toads' song during the mating season.
items.name: Hatter Lily

items.description: Thanks to this hat, Eniripsas always know how to deal with emergencies. Indeed, all the first aid tips are discreetly written on the lining. It makes them look as if they just graduated even though no one would normally wear such a ridiculous hat even for a school ceremony!

effects.formatted: Stimulating Word: line of sight off
Word of Decline: line of sight off
Vampiric Word: line of sight off

items.name: Hat Wisholdoo

items.description: You might have expected this headgear to be a handsome orange colour. It's nothing of the sort. Not only that, this fashion accessory is more of a mask than a cap... So why did the creators decide to call it a Cap Ricott? Probably just to get people talking about it!
items.name: Cap Ricott

items.description: The sharpened points coming out of this cap not only enable you to hurt your enemy but also increase your chances of being struck on the head by lightning during a storm. Indeed, Sacriers are a class who love to hurt others as much as themselves. A nice smell of grilled meat: nothing's better to start your day!
items.name: Cap Rayer

items.description: Thanks to this headgear, you'll really look like a horny beast. People will turn round to admire the huge pair on your head. This roomy hood can also keep food fresh like hay for Gobballs or bread for Tofus.
items.name: Cool Hood

items.description: This helmet can make wearers make promises they instantly forget. Is it because it exerts pressure on the part of the brain which deals with memory or language? No one truly knows. What matters is to only take into account the less extravagant words.
items.name: Helmet Hicc

items.description: Robbie Hood was a famous Cra who lived in the woods. This explains the camouflage green colour of the cap. He wanted to take the law into his own hands and spent all his time stealing money from the rich for a good cause: himself!
items.name: Robbie Hoodie Cap

items.description: Fecas increase their luck, as well as that of their allies when they wear this hat. If you've hired a Feca who's wearing the Zinda Hood, you're sure to arrive safely and almost without a scratch. The problem is, it smells so foul that it's only useful for protecting widows and orphans.
items.name: Zinda Hood

items.description: This hood can be used to fend off the bad weather, but it's also great for cooking. It allows you to regulate the strength of a flame with a tip of the head. Now you know why Enutrofs have such muscular necks.
items.name: Sthood

items.description: The floating cape will give you the aura of a warrior, especially when you turn your back to your enemy. Some think it's reinforced by a metal sheet capable of staving off the slyest attacks.

effects.formatted: Sword of Fate: straight-line casting off

items.name: Cloak Orporal

items.description: Cut from a soft and strong fabric, this cape gives the Ecaflips the impression that they're always the best, no matter what happens. When they win, they love to wear this piece of clothing and claim their reward: "And now, gimme the cash!"
items.name: Cape of Spades

items.description: This cape is so light and thin that the slightest wind, wind of any sort, will blow it off... It's anything but discreet especially after a meal of veggies and fermented drinks.
items.name: F-Ha(r)t

items.description: The dark colour of this cape makes it easy to match any other cloth, of any colour. Since it's a very wide cape, it can also protect your head and nose.
items.name: Cap Cape

items.description: Place the cape lightly on your shoulders to prevent stiff joints, stiff upper lips and other stiffness-related problems.

effects.formatted: Life-Giving Word: line of sight off
Galvanising Word: line of sight off

items.name: Cape Sulitis

items.description: This item is used to hide the Sadidas' weight problem. Because they spend most of their time sleeping instead of practicing sports, the characters of this class tend to become rather stout. If Sadidettes actually have anti-starvation supplies flatteringly placed in the eyes of men, Sadidas usually use this cape to hide theirs.
items.name: Cape o'Tbelly

items.description: This piece of clothing plays an essential part in the Sacriers' style. They use it to bandage their wounds, to clean off blood, to warm their feet during the cold seasons. We cannot say it enough - this class is terrified of frozen ground!

effects.formatted: Light Speed: occupied cell needed off

items.name: Cape Ytal

items.description: This soft cape is sometimes used by the Osamodettes as a wide-brimmed hat. Male Osamodas only use it as a cape. Thanks to the drawing which decorates this piece of clothing, this character class has inherited the reputation of being frank... they can't laugh up their sleeves since the laugh has actually been sewn onto the cape!
items.name: Cape Anama

items.description: Pandawas use this cape as protection against bad weather and as a dance accessory. They put it on the floor, in the middle of a circle of tipsy dancers. Then they start their improvised choreography during which their feet can't leave the cloth.
items.name: Cape Wuera

items.description: Let me tell you about Hulco, a very strange Cra. He couldn't find his way to his own bathroom because everything he saw looked like a tropical beach at sunset. At least he never had to pay for a sun holiday.
items.name: Cape Hulco

items.description: This cape's warm and comforting colours take its wearer on an imaginary journey to sunny lands, full of canyons carved by the elements, and cave paintings hidden amongst wind-blasted rocks and weathered cliffs. This is extremely useful way of forgetting the cold, grey, rainy weather.
items.name: Cape Adossia

items.description: Enutrofs have the habit of drawing a map on their cape. They live in such a mess that they can barely find the toilets and this is quite a problem, especially when nature calls urgently.
items.name: Cape Hernaum

items.description: This beautiful belt adds to the prestige of the Iops' appearance. Some say that the central cross can become a detachable weapon when their swords aren't within reach. Obviously this is a legend. Only Srams are deceitful enough to have such things.
items.name: Bloody Belt

items.description: When an Ecaflip is bored, he usually takes his cards from his belt and starts a game of solitaire. In fight, he can also use the cards as projectiles. He draws a card faster than his shadow and once victory is his, there's always time for a little game!
items.name: Belt Sterous

items.description: This belt owes its name to the unusual noise it makes. The bones decorating the belt bang together, preventing Srams, even those who are invisible, from sneaking up on their enemies unannounced. Surprise someone wearing a Clinkin Belt? You've got a snowball in the Obsidemon's Hypogeum's chance!
items.name: Clinkin Belt

items.description: The incessant ticking sound of the clock system of this belt prevents Xelors from sleeping when fights last forever. It is strongly advised that you take this belt off before going to bed.

effects.formatted: Slow Down: line of sight off

items.name: Sleepless Belt

items.description: Though it won't stop the sobbing, this belt will hold lots of medical supplies. This is especially important for Eniripsas... when they have a sore throat, they can't cast their spells properly. And when they're voiceless ... well, they're as useful as a bear skin jacket in a heat wave.

effects.formatted: Overwhelming Word: line of sight off
Discouraging Word: line of sight off

items.name: Blub Belt

items.description: The reason the designers of this fashion accessory put the doll head next to the crotch is still unknown.
items.name: Belt Atio

items.description: Warriors of an ancient tribe renowned for their love for blood, the Pados may have been the first worshippers of the goddess Sacrier. Despite its harmless appearance, this belt is a real sophisticated instrument of torture.
items.name: Strap Pado

items.description: Osamodas are known to be quite touchy, and can fly off the handle at the slightest thing. The numerous buckles and horns on this belt are there to help them rein in this anger, as touching them and counting out loud is supposed to be quite calming.
items.name: Diezzle Belt

items.description: This belt helps Pandawas stand up straight (or almost) when they're drunk which they are, most of the time. In these moments, they tend to feel like they're stuck to the ground though gravity has no link whatsoever to this sensation. Gravity is way too busy knocking out scientists with Apis.
items.name: Sticky Strap

items.description: This belt enables you to keep up baggy clothes (so as not to scare away sensitive souls) and it also offers a target to apprentice Cras. Indeed, they're taught to shoot right in the centre but never below the belt.
items.name: Targ Belt

items.description: Always prepared, Fecas keep survival supplies in a small bag. These supplies are mainly bread made from Crackrock stones. Not very tasty, but incredibly long lasting. The girdle belt firmly secures the bags around their waists. Even so, there are still way too many serious injuries caused by falling bags out of negligence or just plain stupidity.
items.name: Girdle Belt

items.description: This belt is a very handy fashion accessory used by male Enutrofs. The map sewn onto it hides the little accidents they have when they get lost looking for the toilets.
items.name: Belt Urgid

items.description: With these boots on, the Iops are always the first to get to the battlefield and start livening the place up. It's common knowledge that this class love to amuse the crowd with their warrior exploits. But they're never taken seriously because of their intelligence, which is inversely proportional to their strength.
items.name: Boot-a-Hoop

items.description: It is said that Sadidas never feel lonely, since they can summon lots of dolls to keep them company. Thanks to these shoes, you too can say goodbye to loneliness! Not only will you be able to talk to them, but they'll be great for hiding aces when you're playing poker. Once you're wearing them, you'll feel really good, even if you are a little ashamed to actually go out with them on.
items.name: Sleephairs

items.description: Imbued with a revolutionary firming agent, these boots will perfect the curvature of your legs and fight the good fight against your death-like Sram complexion. This cream has spectacular effects on Sramettes but seems to be absolutely useless on Srams. Could it be a hormonal problem?
items.name: Boots Hox

items.description: These boots were created by a Xelor artist to help him paint more quickly. And they work! However, they also tend to distort the vision, meaning the artist was incapable of drawing anything but curvy females.

effects.formatted: Passage of Time: +1 cast(s) per target

items.name: Shal'Hal Boots

items.description: These boots will protect you by identifying and neutralising ground-borne toxins. Well, you can never be too suspicious of microbes and other germs, can you? Some pedantic observers enjoy pointing out that they look more like slippers than boots, but that's what Eniripsas call them. I wonder if it's because they're so tiny that they see everything from a different viewpoint.

effects.formatted: Word of Youth: line of sight off
Depressing Word: line of sight off
Bloodless Word: line of sight off

items.name: Antibooties

items.description: Thanks to their recognition system, these boots prevent Sadidas from crushing rare plants. However they won't prevent you from stepping in various sort of excrements if you don't watch where you're going.

effects.formatted: Rise of Sap: +1 cast(s) per turn

items.name: Boots Hanik

items.description: Unlike the other classes, Sacriers love having thorns stuck in their feet and would rather not pull them out. The pain reminds them that they're alive and gives them the raging energy they need to slaughter their enemies. Plus, the drops of blood they leave behind make it impossible to get lost. They can always backtrack – which they wouldn't have been able to do as easily in poor quality shoes.
items.name: Nailed Thongs

items.description: Crocodyl Dandy lost many a good opportunity and many a wife through his undying urge to wander round the outback. His fame grew fast and he was even offered a sponsorship deal by the famed shoemakers of Aerdala, but when he saw what they had on offer, he threw them back and shouted "That's not a pair of boots... THIS is a pair of boots."

effects.formatted: Song of the Phoenix: +2 Maximum Range

items.name: Wawka Boots

items.description: Ross is the favourite pet of the famous Master Black Jack. Don't be put off by its appearance, it can be really fearsome in battle.
items.name: Ross

items.description: Thanks to this pet, anyone of the opposite sex will be making eyes at you. Don't gloat too much, though. Very soon, you'll realise that your suitor has been hypnotised by Feanor. It won't be much of an advantage either: from then on, your admirer will only eat raw Snapper and rub up against your legs... Sounds romantic, doesn't it?
items.name: Feanor

items.description: Like Brice said: "It's not the size that counts, it's the sharpness."
items.name: Sword Hikk

items.description: Created by Khelebragon's love for the priestess Methea, this Dofus is full of nostalgia. Don't gaze at it too long, or you might feel like crying... which might damage your reputation as a stone-cold adventurer.

effects.formatted:
Nebulous Dream:
• On odd turns, the bearer sacrifices 10% final healing to gain 20% final damage.
• On even turns, the bearer sacrifices 10% final damage to gain 20% final healing.

items.name: Cloudy Dofus

items.description: You'll always have an out-of-bed look if you wear this hat, even if you've spent hours brushing your hair. The hairs on a Tynril's bark curl when the weather is humid, which makes it the surest weather forecaster in the World. This hat fears fire, however, so be extremely careful and keep it away from flames if you don't want to become a human torch.
items.name: Tynril Hat

items.description: This sumptuous sword used to belong to a famous thief who was renowned for getting nicked every time he committed a crime.
items.name: Nicked Sword

items.description: If you shake your two little bells, you might be able to play music.
items.name: Jester Hat

items.description: In some countries, it seems that Geta Bernacle are thrown at the feet of enemies to propose a duel. It's a little like hitting your opponent with a pair of gloves. The advantage of using Geta Bernacle is that they add the stench factor to the actual blow. Pandawas never were famous for their foot hygiene.
items.name: Geta Bernacle

items.description: Wearing this ring is an honour. It shows that you're a faithful worshipper of the goddess Cra, the only one to reveal how to harden your muscle more quickly to be able fire more effectively.
items.name: Honoh Ring

items.description: Ecaflips have the gift of the gab. They can talk you into almost any bet you can think of. This ring celebrates their business smarts. It can also be used as a spare dice or to scratch yourself.
items.name: Blaber Ring

items.description: Osamodettes love this ring that gives an extra feline touch to their walk. Because they're always so close to monsters, they're starting to behave like true tigers. But in reality, they're as devoted and caring as mother Boowolfines.
items.name: Lion Ring

items.description: Spiteful gossips claim that this ring is the least useful fashion accessory in the World. The wings attached to it are very awkward when you need to get a tissue out of your pocket. Now, as Iops have neither tissues nor pockets, they don't care. Instead, they prefer shredding their enemies' flesh with the wings during close combat. Thinking about it, you wonder why this isn't the Sacriers' ring instead.
items.name: Ring Bellious

items.description: Fecas use the mini shields on this ring as memo boards to write love notes and to-do lists. This jewel has been nicknamed the anti-forgetfulness shield. However, it does not protect you from stammering or slips of the tongue.

effects.formatted: Shepherd's Crook: line of sight off

items.name: Memo Ring

items.description: Enutrofs can use this ring to evoke the memory of their happiest times whenever they want. If one removes the miniature shovel driven into the ring, it will give off a gentle aroma. To make the memory even more potent, you'd need to add a specific smell to it, and that's not the easiest thing to do, let me tell you.

effects.formatted: Spade of the Ancients: modifiable Range
Shovel of the Ancients: +2 Maximum Range

items.name: Rememb Ring

items.description: The goddess Eniripsa gave this item to her worshippers as a sign of their spiritual union during the class spell initiation session. Incidentally, Eniripsas can also use it as a sponge bracelet to clean off the blood of their allies.

effects.formatted: Frightening Word: line of sight off
Word of Recovery: line of sight off
Uniting Word: line of sight off

items.name: Chee Ring

items.description: This jewel tends to turn Pandawas into insulting devils after two or three beers... just remember the old proverb "Sticks and stones may break my bones, but a drunken bear-like creature will never hurt me."
items.name: Ear Ring

items.description: This jewel with a skull on it was traditionally offered to all Sram kids to reward them for their treachery and blows below the belt. The other classes seem to discredit this practise which tends to overexcite the kids and turn them into little devils.
items.name: Elkebi Ring

items.description: This ring is the only jewel that can tell the time and which is perfectly waterproof. Some believe that if you enlarge it a few hundred times, it'll make a submarine too. A submarine that can tell the time.
items.name: Subma Ring

items.description: Contrary to the rumour, Sadidas do not let their hair down... This hair has just been adjusted round a wonderful ring to reinforce its benefits. Never ever cut it! Thanks to the Hai Ring, you'll always be perfect!
items.name: Hai Ring

items.description: If you see a character who's not a Sacrier wear the Ring Neinwonwon, take him directly to intensive care. Indeed, this jewel is extremely harmful. In general, people lose their cool when they face the pool of blood caused by this ring.
items.name: Ring Neinwonwon

items.description: These shoes enable their wearer to dance all night long, despite blisters and corns! They dance to the rhythm of the night and make a little "beep beep" sound when they're next to religious artefacts. You'll be bright as a button the next day too, ready for a bit of slaughter.
items.name: Crusuede Shoes

items.description: When Fecas are embarrassed and wish to change the subject, they always mention their Relief Boots. They talk about the way you can pace up and down all sorts of landscapes with them on. When their allies are in trouble on the battlefield, these comfy boots help them recover and ward off the threat.

effects.formatted: Black Ice: line of sight off

items.name: Relief Boots

items.description: The numerous straps around these shoes can be used as spare bow strings. Young Craettes also use them to cook vegetables. The smell of feet doesn't seem to bother them.
items.name: Veggie Boots

items.description: Made from Mopy King Fabric, this cape is riddled with micro-holes that allow sweat to escape more easily during periods of intense exercise - during aggressive melees in steamy swamps, for example. The holes may let the humidity out, but they keep the heat in, and so you always stay dry, whatever the situation. It's just a pity the stench of mould is so hard to shift.
items.name: Mopy King Sovereign Cape

items.description: This cape may not be as powerful as the fancier Mopy King version, but it still has the same sweat evacuation system. You'll be able to face any situation wearing it, as long as you're able to fight while holding your breath, that is. The stench is truly unbearable!
items.name: Ouassingual Cape

items.description: This sturdy wooden mask will have you fearlessly facing all kinds of dangers, which isn't surprising given that it completely blocks your view.
items.name: Zoth Sergeant Mask

items.description: From a distance, this hat looks like a lampshade with two holes for the eyes. It looks the same up close actually.
items.name: Zoth Disciple Hat

items.description: This mask won't help you avoid or heal hangovers, but at least it gives you some chance of hiding the effects.
items.name: Light Treeckler Mask

items.description: This mask won't help you avoid or heal hangovers, but at least it gives you some chance of hiding the effects. The dark touch simply indicates that you're in a bad mood... and that you should not be annoyed and you're ready to throw a flurry of blows to anyone who does not respect that!
items.name: Dark Treeckler Mask

items.description: You'll look like a Snailmet if you wear this hat. Of course it will protect your head from blows, but does that make up for the slobber all over your head?
items.name: Snailmet

items.description: Bigger, heavier and more powerful, this mace makes a louder noise when smashing the enemies. But curiously, it's lighter and has a better grip to it. The Coralator we used to make it wasn't great for no reason!
items.name: Great Coralator Mace

items.description: Despite her small size, the Zoth Girl carries a huge hammer. It's a way to reinforce her muscle structure. No need to add weights around her wrists and ankles to increase her strength. Dragging the hammer is quite enough!
items.name: Zoth Girl Hammer

items.description: The Zoth Warrior is used to carrying two axes because he can't reach his enemy's left side with his right hand. It's hard to tell whether it is due to a lack of self-confidence or if he was just born clumsy!
items.name: Zoth Warrior Axe

items.description: The Cheeken is an awkward, winged creature which has as much energy as a Tofu with avian flu.
items.name: Cheeken Wig

items.description: This hat is large enough to hide Barbrossa's ridiculously hairless head and beard. But it won't cover big-headed skulls.
items.name: Barbrossa's Hat

items.description: This hammer took its nice colour from the pieces of Coralator used to make it. Unlike what people think, it was not originally used to crush Iops and other enemies, but as a door-knocker for the hard of hearing.
items.name: Coralator Mace

items.description: This branch was apparently used to scrape some otherwise inaccessible body part. But don't worry, the dark colour is authentic, it's got nothing to do with the various sorts of deposits contained in the inaccessible cavities of the Treeckler.
items.name: Dark Treeckler Branch

items.description: This branch was apparently used to scrape some otherwise inaccessible body part. This might explain the stick's stickiness.
items.name: Light Treeckler Branch

items.description: Rotaflors use their stem to clean their ears. Sculptors, however, prefer to use them as weapons. Proof, indeed, that there's no accounting for taste.
items.name: Rotaflor Stem

items.description: This staff completely binds the Zoth Master, making him fearless and therefore formidable. When it comes to eating though, it makes an awful mess.
items.name: Zoth Master Staff

items.description: Just like weeds, Tynrils can breed infinitely thanks to this simple piece of rhizome. After making this discovery some greedy staffmakers made a staff from Tynril and tried to breed it. It was a miserable failure.
items.name: Tynril Rhizome

items.description: This Voodoo mask serves primarily to hide and protect the faces of those who, like Thierry, like slingshots, but often miss their target.
items.name: Thierry Voodoo Mask

items.description: When Jav Kanniballs feel a little blue, they dye their hair this colour. Is it due to frustrated love or something else? Hard to know for sure, but it would be great if they could just wear the mask and stop telling everyone how sad they were.
items.name: Jav Voodoo Mask

items.description: Many moons ago, the Kanniballs were travelling actors respected for their comedies and tragedies, as represented by two masks - one laughing, the other cruel. When their chief lost the happy mask, the Kanniballs descended into savagery.
items.name: Sarbak Voodoo Mask

items.description: Kanniball archers can't concentrate and aim right unless they are very angry. So, in order to be sure to see red at all times, they painted their masks this colour.
items.name: Archer Voodoo Mask

items.description: When he puts on this hat, Crocodyl Dandy thinks he's at the forefront of fashion. Fashion must be pretty dull if that's the case. However, it'd be best if you didn't let him know how ridiculous he looks, after all, he is particularly touchy.
items.name: Crocodyl Dandy's Hat

items.description: This hood serves as a royal headdress, and shares the same virtues as the Mopy King Sovereign Cape. Its micro-vents allow sweat to drain away more easily, so you'll always have a cool head. Unfortunately, it shares the same defects as the cape: its foul stench is so strong, you could cut it with a knife.
items.name: Mopy King Sovereign Hood

items.description: It may be less efficient than the Sovereign Hood, but it still allows for a good draining of the sweat. Maybe too good, actually. As a result, whether you wear it or not, it won't make any difference.
items.name: Ouassingual Hood

items.description: The Zoth Girl's hat makes her see double. Strange. This is the reason she lisps.
items.name: Zoth Girl Hat

items.description: This helmet has the same advantages as other Zoth hats - it'll protect you from the sun no matter how hot it is, from blows dealt on the head, and it prevents the wearer from being aware of the danger by restricting his visual field. Anyway, this is the perfect warrior headgear.
items.name: Zoth Warrior Helmet

items.description: The main advantage of the Zoth Master Hat is that it restricts your field of view far more than any other helmet. Thanks to this peculiarity, the wearer can use the famous fighting technique known as "The Weasel". In short, this method consists of striking anywhere using all your strength. As it's completely unpredictable, you're guaranteed to defeat your opponent (or at least surprise them enough to finish them off with a well-placed kick).
items.name: Zoth Master Hat

items.description: This stick is a firm favourite with the trunk-women. But it'll seduce any old kind of girl. Probably.
items.name: Barkritter Root

items.description: If you're superstitious and always need to knock on wood, use the Floramor Root! On the other hand, you should try to be careful not to saw the branch you're sitting on and especially not to get your fingers in the way!
items.name: Floramor Root

items.description: You say that a kraken, with the foulest breath you've ever seen, follows you wherever you go? Well, deal with it: it's only a tiny inconvenience that comes with the hat!
items.name: Crack Sparrow's Own Withered Hat

items.description: When the Bherb has got butterflies, he wears his Bherbal belt and healthily eliminates them.
items.name: Bherbal Bherb Belt

items.description: These boots create a disgusting suction noise with each step, which will remind you of a rutting Trool's love chant if you've ever heard it. A painful memory that you could easily live without.
items.name: Boots Kwish

items.description: This seal indicates that its owner is the undisputed sovereign of Otomai Island's Bottomless Peat Bog, although it's difficult to imagine a more pastoral kingdom...
items.name: Mopy King Sovereign Seal

items.description: This ring was pulled off the still-warm finger of a freshly slaughtered Coralator. His mother was expecting him for dinner, until she saw he'd been transformed into a tombstone.  Coralators are not as stone-hearted as people might imagine.
items.name: Coral Ring

items.description: Only Kimbos, with their weird feet, feel comfortable in these sandals. However, they're not the only ones who can benefit from their powers. But be careful not to wear them the wrong way!
items.name: Round Kimbo Sandals

items.description: Parkinn Pan truly believed that he could fly thanks to this belt trimmed with Pikoko wings, but what he didn't know was that very few Pikokos can actually fly. That's why every time he jumped off the Tree Keeholo he routinely crashed to the forest floor below. His nickname "Cake" comes from "flat as a pancake".
items.name: Parkinn Pan's Pikokowal Belt

items.description: This amulet might be nothing more than a few pieces of wood bound with a strip of torn fabric, but the Zoths are absolutely convinced it has terrible powers. The doddery old fools!
items.name: Zothulet

items.description: This bow string is made of Snailmet Slobber, not too dry with a unique elasticity. However, its slimy and gooey texture reminds you of, well, nothing really, but it's quite unpleasant.
items.name: Snailmet Bow

items.description: Carved in a Snailmet carapace, this ring can resist anything and anyone.
items.name: Snailmet Ring

items.description: Woven from Zoth fabrics, this cape has extraordinary powers of unknown origin.
items.name: Powerful Dazzling Cloak

items.description: With this cape on, you'll be craving for some vinaigrette.
items.name: Moopet Cape

items.description:
The Cheeken Beak on this weapon is absolutely useless, and can be more of a handicap than anything else.
Fortunately, it is quite powerful.
items.name: Cheeken Axe

items.description: These boots are so heavy that they should actually be categorised as weapons. Indeed, they make the slightest kick lethal.
items.name: Wooden Treeckler Boots

items.description: Carved in a Dark Treeckler, this belt isn't pliable enough to let you move around easily, but at least, it'll protects you.
items.name: Dark Treeckler Belt

items.description: Carved from a Light Treeckler, this belt won't afford you great protection, but at least it is soft enough to let you move around freely.
items.name: Light Treeckler Belt

items.description: This jewel is not precious but is the perfect size to balance the moorgale in a nice belgroot flavoured with a hint of Glaviooze.
items.name: Ring Dikuloos

items.description: Finally a good excuse to smell of the sea!
items.name: Krabelt

items.description: This jewel sometimes tries to steal some of your food when you're eating, so don't let it hang down too low.
items.name: Ouassulet

items.description: This strange cape seems to be made of black ink, but oddly enough, it behaves just like fabric - it doesn't run. As for stains, well, that's another matter. Your backside will never be clean again.
items.name: Inky Veil

items.description: Once round your finger, you won't be able to take it off, ever. Its suckers are way too powerful.
items.name: Kringlove

items.description: This hammer is not handy, not particularly good looking, not very ergonomic, not powerful, too light, too fragile, unbalanced, too shiny and smelly. But at least it's got pretty colours.
items.name: Kidommer

items.description: Unfortunately, this ring is only polished on the outside. You put your finger through a hole full of sharp rock fragments. It is recommended for Sacriers.
items.name: Polished Ring

items.description: It's the Mufafah moustaches that cause the wearer of this necklace to bellow so loudly. Why? They hang down and tickle the nipples constantly.
items.name: Amufafah

items.description: Solo was a nice good-for-nothing, and he admitted as much himself. That didn't stop him from being hanged on the village square for stealing a thong belonging to the chief's wife. Solo wasn't a bright guy, no, but he was a nice guy all the same.
items.name: Solo's Ring

items.description: In theory, this helmet should keep your wig on your head if you decide to go ride a Scaraleaf. Simply priceless!
items.name: Improved Helmet

items.description: These improved wooden wings have been padded and made lighter thanks to feathers and high-quality fabric. Since the frame is still in wood, it will be hard not to crash!
items.name: Improved Wooden Wings

items.description: Once upon a time, a man named Rahm got lost in the jungle. Have you heard of Viet Rham?
items.name: Rahm Bow

items.description: This strange bow was carved by a Sadidette during a very productive sleep-stroll. Just looking at it makes you feel sleepy - that goes for the archer as well as the target.
items.name: Little Bow Sleep

items.description: These daggers are perfect for pushing Pineapis and shaking trees, or pushing Pineapis and grinding coffee, if that's what takes your fancy. Just remember: to the left, to the right, jump up and down and to the knees.
items.name: Dagger Doo

items.description: Long ago there lived a mad Sram called Gaga... this guy, he robbed from the poor and gave to the rich.
items.name: Gaga Daggers

items.description: Porkeez is a better drinker than he is a fighter, and let me tell you he doesn't get any better as time passes by. All the same I wouldn't go around looking like a cork when he's got his daggers out.
items.name: Porkeez Daggers

items.description: This should not be mistaken for the famous staff of similar name. The blades on this implement spill far more blood.
items.name: Kriss Tobal

items.description: Many a proud adventurer refused this weapon because of its colour. Many the same died by its blade.
items.name: Fuchsia

items.description: This sword used to belong to an old, power-hungry Enutrof. Just like his ego, it's made of solid gold.
items.name: Az'tech

items.description: Smile! Say cheese! Perfect! Sliced in half!
items.name: Kukri Kura

items.description: Ourag'han was an old Pandawa with skin so soft he was known as Slippiderm. His odour on the other hand gave rise to another name altogether. He christened his trusty axe likewise.
items.name: Sick Axe

items.description: Driven into a horticidal rage when a mischievous squirrel stole a grain of his rice during a summer holiday on Pandala Island, Brouce Boulgoure used this axe to flatten each and every bamboo shoot the squirrel hopped onto.  The Pandawas in the village had to feed him half their stock of bamboo wine to keep him from razing the entire forest. Trust old Broucey.
items.name: Michael Dougle Axe

items.description: Even as a young Iopette, Mel dreamt of slaying dragons. With a spade for a sword and a rock for a dragon, she honed her skills in the back yard. The mere mention of a shovel now has the poor rock in convulsions.
items.name: Hickory Shovel

items.description: This is a wild shovel which tries to bite its owner each time it's picked up. It makes the most unusual sounds when it's happy and can only be pacified with the soothing sound of chimes.
items.name: Shovel Shattkitou

items.description: A cunning Enutrof became a pirate after noticing that there were more treasures to be found on fresh corpses than in rotten graves. This blood-red shovel was his symbol and filled the sailors of the Asse Sea with terror.
items.name: Shovel Egant

items.description: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: This sword will teach you that there's a bit of misfortune hidden in the best of luck.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: Ecaflip held out his godly paw to you but all you found was a claw, and it's not as sharp as you first thought. Maybe it wasn't a god after all.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: Superstitious folk believe that a simple wodent leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, they'll gaze upon you with awe. Plus, its blade is extremely sharp, and it reminds you of another sword you used to know.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: Superstitious folk believe that a simple wodent leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, they'll gaze upon you with awe. Plus, its blade is extremely sharp, and it reminds you of another sword you used to know.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: Superstitious folk believe that a simple wodent leg around the neck can bring you luck and fortune. Thanks to this legendary sword, they'll gaze upon you with awe. Plus, its blade is extremely sharp, and it reminds you of another sword you used to know.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: "Fortune favours the brave", whisper the disciples of Ecaflip. Now you're ready, you'll be able to show us how you play. This pure, prestigious sword is extremely rare.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: "Fortune favours the brave", whisper the disciples of Ecaflip. Now you're ready, you'll be able to show us how you play. This pure, prestigious sword is extremely rare.
items.name: Ecaflip Paw

items.description: This sword represents the incarnation of the god Ecaflip's luck. You're holding in your hands the purest version of the Ecaflip Paw, which testifies to your incredible, yet somehow undignified, luck.
items.name: Perfect Ecaflip Paw

items.description: If you spin around at the speed of sound while wearing this helmet, you'll take off. As for landing, well, you'll have to sort it out.
items.name: Air Pikoko Helmet

items.description: This cold, slimy ring never stops sucking on your finger from the minute you slip it on. If you can see past its flaws, however, its great powers are yours to wield.
items.name: Head Band

items.description: This blade cuts wheat as well as enemies, but it also makes your allies extremely jealous. That's the destiny of powerful people.
items.name: Blord Warrior's Cursed Scythe

items.description: This sword holds an immense power of which the many victims fill chapters in the history books. It's said there's also a cursed scythe, but only the most famous farmer could confirm that.
items.name: Blord Warrior's Cursed Sword

items.description: In his time, Gore Master was very strong and had all he needed - money, women and more. He didn't quite deserve all of it since he got his strength from his nice ring. Until the day he carelessly crossed the street. And BAM! No more Gore Master. Since then, unscrupulous people pass it on to other unscrupulous people.
items.name: Gore Master's Ring (Gms Only)

items.description: Ougaa had a head thicker than anyone else, which is why a hammer created from the skull of this redoubtable deity is perfect for crushing those of others.
items.name: Ougaammer

items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way around your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.
items.name: Morello Cherry Blop Ring

items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.
items.name: Pippin Blop Ring

items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.
items.name: Coco Blop Ring

items.description: Once it wraps its Bloppish way round your finger, it's impossible to get rid of this ring.
items.name: Indigo Blop Ring

items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.
items.name: Royal Morello Cherry Blop Ring

items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.
items.name: Royal Pippin Blop Ring

items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.
items.name: Royal Coco Blop Ring

items.description: Kroula had a plan. He was going to put this ring on his big toe, get Blops to lick his feet and collect litres of Royal Blop juice. Well, the ring didn't fit.
items.name: Royal Indigo Blop Ring

items.description: This rough copy of the great Ougaa should be worn around the neck, with a hungry stare and a well-kept beard to boot.
items.name: Ougaamulet

items.description: A young Cra named Colette lost her head in Eltneg Wood. The poor girl stepped in the way of Brouce Boulgoure's hatchet, which he threw thinking she was a giant fern. Lucky she didn't live – she would have died had she found out she looked like a giant fern.
items.name: Colette's Ring

items.description: Are you too young to get into the good clubs? Are you nervous around girls? Well, stick this ring on your finger, and hold it in front of your upper lip. It'll add a few years to your age and do wonders for your self-confidence. Just don't go out in strong winds, or it'll blow away, like your quickly evaporating self-esteem.
items.name: Tash Ring

items.description: If your enemies are allergic to mushrooms, let them nibble your fingers.
items.name: Fungal Ring

items.description: This bow is made from sharp, thin, very flexible slats that are more often used to make beds than deadly weapons. Now they're used to bring on a more permanent sort of sleep.
items.name: Beddy Bow

items.description: Originally, blowing hard into this trumpet-shaped fungal wand would call Jon Lemon, the wandering minstrel, to the scene of battle. He'd then begin singing and everyone who hadn't blocked their ears would die on the spot. Since this made it a bit too easy to kill monsters, the gods decided to plug the trumpet and turn it into a relatively harmless wand.
items.name: Wanderelle

items.description: The three points of this staff attract particles of plasmogrine present in the quadramental breeze. Carefully lick the points of the stick, align them with the hands of an inverted Xelor clock, count to sixty (try six if you're a Iop) and squeeze your buttocks together. You'll have a fifty-fifty chance of being hit by lightning or turning your enemies into grizzly Kirballs.
items.name: Mush Mishish Staff

items.description: These knives were once used to remove the fungus that infested the feet of adventurers. Removing the fungus actually means removing both feet, just below the knees.
items.name: Mush Cuteers

items.description: The different blades of this axe can be used to cut sausage very quickly. One blow is sufficient to produce three slices. It's not quite as useful when it comes to killing enemies, unless you're used to eating nothing but sliced food, of course.
items.name: Canni Blade

items.description: These boots are the perfect thing to put on if you want to go for a walk in the woods without crushing any dead leaves. You'll need to be careful, however, as their vegetal origins inevitably drive them to crush anything remotely related to manure.
items.name: Ta Boots

items.description: Contrary to popular misconception, the holes in these shoes are not there to let your feet breathe, but to let the spawn of your foot fungus escape and infect the feet of other footloose adventurers.
items.name: Spore Boots

items.description: If there wasn't so much mould on this rag, it would make a great tablecloth. Not to worry, you can always dry the dishes with it when your guests aren't watching.
items.name: Ragoat

items.description: One more glass for the road? Ah, well, roads are long and nights are short, so this cape is usually used to keep the barflies warm as they finish their endless rounds of night caps. It'll kill them in the end, you know.
items.name: Deadly Night Cape

items.description: As its name suggests, this string assassinates any flies that get too close to your sweet spots. Just one piece of advice - never, ever pull it off a loved one with your teeth.
items.name: Stringsecticide

items.description: The best way to solve crotch fungus is to lure it elsewhere. As there's no longer room between your toes to accommodate any more fungi, you can use this belt, a truly impressive residence for any fungus worthy of the name.
items.name: Fungas Belt

items.description: Take an Elm, strip the bark off, soak it for a few months in a muddy puddle, cover it with fungal infections, stick it under your bed for a week while you sleep on the floor, basting it regularly with Blop fat. All you need to know to make an Elm belt that stinks. Are you happy now?
items.name: Slice of Undergrowth

items.description:
The tag on this belt says 'Sorry, but if you're looking for a way to get Ougaa's power, this belt is not for you.'
Well that's just great, isn't it.
items.name: Ougaabelt

items.description: Take a Dora, cover it in Gobball Slobber and Iop sweat, let it stew for a couple of weeks and you'll get an idea of the intoxicating effects of the Mush Ombrero. Try to stay away from heavy machinery while you wear it. In fact, stay away from anything that's heavy.
items.name: Mush Ombrero

items.description: Instead of cutting down on impure Blop juice, Shika Ingalsse pressed on with her harvest through her inebriated state. One day, as she was stumbling and falling through the golden fields, Shika landed on this ring. Whoever said that impure Blop juice should be taken in moderation?
items.name: Royal Rainbow Blop Ring

items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.
items.name: Morello Cherry Amublop

items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.
items.name: Pippin Amublop

items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.
items.name: Coco Amublop

items.description: When Lorkos set off on his trip to the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, the first thing he did was put on his Amublop. No one ever found out why.
items.name: Indigo Amublop

items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.
items.name: Royal Morello Cherry Amublop

items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.
items.name: Royal Pippin Amublop

items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.
items.name: Royal Coco Amublop

items.description: This Amublop costs a lot more to make than an ordinary Amublop, but look on the bright side... it will sell for a lot more too, especially if you offload it on an Astrubian.
items.name: Royal Indigo Amublop

items.description: They have to put heaps of artificial colourants and flavourings into this amulet to stop it coming out white when it's crafted. A word of advice, it might look great and smell delicious, but don't try to eat it.
items.name: Royal Rainbow Amublop

items.description: Does it make your mouth feel funny when you say the name of this object? Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face-to-face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot... Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad you have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.
items.name: Morello Cherry Bloopts

items.description: Does it make your mouth feel funny when you say the name of this object? Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face to face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot.. Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad to have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.
items.name: Pippin Bloopts

Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face to face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot.. Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad to have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.
items.name: Coco Bloopts

items.description: Does it make your mouth feel funny when you say the name of this object? Well, let me tell you, if you find yourself face to face with a highway robber who asks you for your 'Boot.. Bloops... Bloo...', you'll be glad to have just enough time to scurry off while he figures out how to pronounce the word. So stop your complaining.
items.name: Indigo Bloopts

items.description: Say the word Bloopts ten times fast while spinning round in circles. Now you know what it feels like to be a Iop.
