items.name: Neckross

items.description: People say that the Fugitives sprouted wings after downing too many Raid Boole Potions. This cloak offers some of the same effects, although there's no guarantee you won't regret wearing it.
items.name: Krosscape

items.description: With shoes like these, pesky electrocutions during voyages through time will be a thing of the past!
items.name: Kroks

items.description: If someone gazes pointedly into this pendant for 42 hours straight, they will be completely under your command.
items.name: Talismagic

items.description: Oh! Were you planning to wear this ring on your finger? It's a belt, silly!
items.name: Belt of Wonders

items.description: Bootini was one of the finest magicians of all time, and yet fate has decided that he will be best known for sharing his name with these silly boots. (Just try and get out of them once they're on, though!)
items.name: Great Bootinis

items.description: These boots will let you kick your enemies' butts 42 times faster than before.
items.name: XLII Boots

items.description: This belt has the pointiest demon horns you've ever seen. Woe betide the tipsy adventurer who decides to greet you with a friendly hip bump.
items.name: XLII Belt

items.description: Now when someone asks you the meaning of life, the universe and everything, giving them the finger whilst wearing this ring should suffice.
items.name: XLII Ring

items.description: This belt will either boost your masculinity, or make you look impossibly ridiculous. Luck of the draw.
items.name: Siks-T Belt

items.description: This topper comes from the deepest, most demonic realm and is imbued with time-old magic. When you put it on, you will look like a backing vocalist from a boyband. You can't have it all!
items.name: Siks-T Hairpiece

items.description: Don't get me wrong, I hate demons as much as the next fella, but there's something comforting about cuddling up with a pair of slippers lined with their armpit hair.
items.name: Siks-T Slippers

items.description: "Nananananananana FRAKTAL!" Yep. You're practically a superhero now.
items.name: Fraktal Hat

items.description: Lifting this wand straight up into the air during a storm is enough to transport you through time. I mean, everyone else who's tried it has vanished and never returned, so it seems to work fine.
items.name: Fugitive Wand

items.description: This belt has several amazing properties, including the ability to reproduce infinite quantities of its own logo. Not bad for hypnotising your enemies.
items.name: Fraktal Belt

items.description: Paradoxically, this hammer is most effective when the pointy end is used.
items.name: Fugitive Hammer

items.description: You probably think there's no feather on earth that could cut you into bits... Why not let this be the feather to prove you wrong?
items.name: Plumobile

items.description: Although this ring is extremely fragile, it will make you hugely powerful. Just make sure you don't sit on it by accident.
items.name: Fraktal Ring

items.description: This ring will show the world that the thing it needs to fear the most is you (well, kind of).
items.name: Xelomorph Ring

items.description: There's nothing scarier than a Xelomorph staring at you with its big, shining eyes... So just imagine how frightened your enemies will be when they see you in these boots!
items.name: Xelomorph Boots

items.description: This semi-transparent cloak adapts to suit its wearer's look and makes them look even more imposing.
items.name: Xelomorph Cloak

items.description: Nobody knows why, but the moment you pull on this balaclava, you are filled with an insatiable hunger for acorns. Chomp!
items.name: Akornaddikt Balaclava

items.description: Perfect for all your country walks, these boots will help you become friends with the animals!
items.name: Akornaddikt Boots

items.description: This amulet, which was made out of an Akornaddikt tail, is so soft and fluffy that you can't stop stroking yourself with it. That's normal, right?
items.name: Akornaddikt Amulet

items.description: There's nothing like a little bolt from the blue to pep you up when all you want is a nice nap.
items.name: Electrobolt

items.description: The temporal convector embedded in the head of this hammer was invented by Doc Ettem Bworn. As for what it does... We're still trying to figure that out.
items.name: Chronomagic Hammer

items.description:
"You shall not pass!" 
These words suit your new pet to a tee. Still, don't expect it to stand between you and certain death, as it lacks both courage and muscles.
items.name: Blokus

items.description: Are you the kind that shrinks away from a scrap? Do you have delusions of grandeur? The Rikiki wand is perfect for you. You can also use it to slip into inaccessible areas... soon, no mouse hole will be unknown to you.
items.name: Rikiki Wand

items.description: If, while cleaning this ring, you notice a golden dust coming off it, think happy thoughts; perhaps you'll be able to fly, as if by magic...
items.name: Tinkly Bell Ring

items.description: Appreciate a good match? Like to strike it lucky? Then this cape is made for you! Just make sure you don't rub against any rough surfaces, or you may find it goes up in smoke.
items.name: Match Cape

items.description: Has anyone ever told you you have a brain the size of a peanut? Well, with this helmet you'll finally have enough protection for it to come out of its shell.
items.name: Nut Helmet

items.description: Worn around the neck, this pearl is a beautiful jewel. And a nice way to recycle an earring if you've lost one half of the pair.
items.name: Pearl Amulet

items.description: This needle-shaped pendant grants the power to heal even the most serious of injuries... If you know how to use it.
items.name: Curative Pendant

items.description: The liquid flowing in this belt has superior healing properties and provides instant relief for nagging back pain!
items.name: Anaesthetising Belt

items.description: Feeling tense? Rub this ring against your skin and feel your muscles instantly relax. The light scent of menthol will also be a great improvement on your usual odour.
items.name: Soothing Ring

items.description: Panthyrozy used to hide her face behind this mask, and not only when she was up to mischief! Her beauty was so great, it would have driven even the hardest of men mad...
items.name: Panthyrozy's Mask

items.description: It may look harmless but the end of this belt can be used as a fearsome whip against all who stand in your path.
items.name: Whipping String

items.description: The ideal accessory for any robbery! Make quick work of any window with this ring, which is as sharp as diamond.
items.name: Cutting Ring

items.description: Armed with this bracelet, you will be kept informed about the forces of pressure acting upon your body. Now, that may not seem useful anywhere beyond the deepest depths of the oceans... and in fact it isn't.
items.name: Deep Sea Bracelet

items.description: These waterproof sandals are the product of advanced technological developments, and will keep your feet dry in any circumstances.
items.name: Deep Sea Sandals

items.description: This mask will help you see clearly in even the darkest areas, and will provide all the oxygen you need to go deep-sea diving.
items.name: Deep Sea Mask

items.description: This Dofus was fashioned on the basis of someone's hazy recollection of what an authentic dragon egg looked like. Touching it causes long-lost memories to come flooding back - it's almost like tasting a Becky Stein cake for the first time in years. You revisit your arrival in Incarnam and the first time you ever slaughtered a Gobbly... Ah, great times!

effects.formatted:
Dimensional Vigil:
• When the bearer ends their turn, heals all allies in line with the bearer for 7% of their HP.

items.name: Watchers Dofus

items.description: The Eliom is a mischievous, chatty spirit that tends to show up around portals created by the Eliotropes. Legends claim that the Eliom is a wandering soul which is not ready for reincarnation just yet. Although it can be irritating, even annoying at times, the Eliom is not evil at heart... It just likes to get into people's ears with its shrill voice.
items.name: Eliom

items.description: Friendrakes are born in an enormous cavern discovered by the Eliotropes beneath the waters of Sufokia. These miniature dragons have long lacked affection, and they make for extremely loyal companions. When a Friendrake adopts you, it's for life! When you go on nights out with your fellow adventurers, you can count on your Friendrake to warm up the room and lighten the mood with the funny faces it makes.
items.name: Friendrake

items.description: It's hard to understand the use of this mask if you haven't used an Eliotrope portal before. Even if you have used one, it's still hard to understand what the mask is for... But at least you can use it to hide your face, and that must be a godsend for someone with a face like yours.
items.name: Krosmetic Mask

items.description: Just like a flying carpet, this will take you around the world. Its secret power? If you gently caress it, it will open up an "Ortal", which you can try to use for faster travel. It's not an Eliotrope Portal, but it's something.
items.name: Ortal Cloak

items.description: With these boots, you can move from A to B using the power of your own two feet. Isn't that amazing? It's so amazing that you can never reveal the secret to anyone. No, seriously! We swear!
items.name: Transit Boots

items.description: If you spin around on the spot very quickly while wearing this belt, something surprising may well happen to you. Although, since no-one who's ever done it is still around to talk about it, nobody knows what this surprise actually is. Give it a try though, you'll see for yourself!
items.name: Cyclone Belt

items.description: Bright like the sun and powerful like a supernova, this ring will augment your Eliotrope powers in a great and terrible way. You're not an Eliotrope? Then you could put it on your bedside table - it would make for a very nice nightlight too. Such is also the power of the Nova Ring.
items.name: Nova Ring

items.description: A wood sculptor had started by carving bows from dead branches found in the Dark Forest. Sadly, they were too soft when drawn and proved to be unusable by the authorities. The sculptor then tried his hand at truncheons made from Soft Oak branches. Surprisingly hard as nails, they were immediately adopted by Brakmar instructors, who continue to use them on the heads of unruly Chafers to this day.
items.name: Old Soft Oak Branch

items.description: A cape specially designed for those who like to hide their cape? Now I've seen it all... or at least I would, if I could see it...
items.name: Invisible Cape

items.description: A very practical head covering to make sure everyone can see your fantastic follicles or lack thereof. As you may have guessed, this hat is for exhibitionists and adventurers with no inhibitions.
items.name: Invisible Hat

items.description: Does your mother-in-law suffer from arachneephobia? Well congratulations, you've found the ideal gift for her next birthday, which will be her last, with any luck.
items.name: Spynner Ring

items.description: Supple and soft to the touch, these boots are incredibly comfortable. But be prepared to be asked to go barefoot by those who hate seeing those creepy crawlies scuttling across their floor.
items.name: Silky Boots

items.description: This hat was a roaring success at the last fashion show organised by the Brakmar Black Widows Association.
items.name: Nephilady Hat

items.description: Some claim that this talisman corrects eyesight problems; while others assure us that it merely multiplies them. The truth, as is often the case, depends on your point of view.
items.name: Eight-Eye Amulet

items.description: If you cross paths with Nevark the Hunter while wearing this cape, he may take you for the acolyte of Arachneeman and give you a good hiding. But you're free to do what you want, after all.
items.name: Caracape

items.description: With this many legs, no one will ever think you're on your last ones.
items.name: Rac Girdle

items.description: If your enemies do not pass away, at least they shall not pass.
items.name: Minor Obstructor

items.description: If your enemies do not pass away, at least they shall not pass.
items.name: Obstructor

items.description: If your enemies do not pass away, at least they shall not pass.
items.name: Major Obstructor

items.description: This Trophy will be of no use to you whilst crossing the desert.
items.name: Minor Deserter

items.description: This Trophy will be of no use to you whilst crossing the desert.
items.name: Deserter

items.description: This Trophy will be of no use to you whilst crossing the desert.
items.name: Major Deserter

items.description: This Trophy will help you heal your allies by offering wise words: "an api a day keeps the doctor away; seven apis a week you'll no longer feel weak"
items.name: Minor Curer

items.description: This Trophy will help you heal your allies by offering wise words: "an api a day keeps the doctor away; seven apis a week you'll no longer feel weak"
items.name: Curer

items.description: This Trophy will help you heal your allies by offering wise words: "an api a day keeps the doctor away; seven apis a week you'll no longer feel weak"
items.name: Major Curer

items.description: It helps to be cured, but not in the ham sense.
items.name: Minor Miracle Man

items.description: It helps to be cured, but not in the ham sense.
items.name: Miracle Man

items.description: It helps to be cured, but not in the ham sense.
items.name: Major Miracle Man

items.description: The saliva on your lips allows you to create a Snailmet trail when you bite the dust.
items.name: Minor Rabid

items.description: The saliva on your lips allows you to create a Snailmet trail when you bite the dust.
items.name: Rabid

items.description: The saliva on your lips allows you to create a Snailmet trail when you bite the dust.
items.name: Major Rabid

items.description: Team up with some Bworks to become the group's intellectual.
items.name: Minor Intellectual

items.description: Team up with some Bworks to become the group's intellectual.
items.name: Intellectual

items.description: Team up with some Bworks to become the group's intellectual.
items.name: Major Intellectual

items.description: Wearing the Forester's Ring originally symbolised commitment to a way of life: sleeping under the stars, climbing trees, eating mushrooms, rolling around in the hay, etc. But now that some are wearing it purely for aesthetic reasons, its meaning has become somewhat devalued. However, it still represents a desire to return to naturism.
items.name: Forester's Ring

items.description: These boots are said to improve Kwismas dinners. Independent studies have shown that wearers of this footwear do show a marked increase in their appreciation for sprouts.
items.name: Springy Boots

items.description: This ring has a different meaning depending on which finger it is worn. For example, on the middle finger, it means you are blossoming.
items.name: Springy Ring

items.description: That pitiful slip on a banana skin was just a stunt to make your friends laugh. No one believed you, but everyone had a good laugh.
items.name: Minor Stunter

items.description: That pitiful slip on a banana skin was just a stunt to make your friends laugh. No one believed you, but everyone had a good laugh.
items.name: Stunter

items.description: That pitiful slip on a banana skin was just a stunt to make your friends laugh. No one believed you, but everyone had a good laugh.
items.name: Major Stunter

items.description: You had a 99% chance of getting a glass half-empty, but you got a glass half-full. How lucky is that!
items.name: Minor Luckster

items.description: You had a 99% chance of getting a glass half-empty, but you got a glass half-full. How lucky is that!
items.name: Luckster

items.description: You had a 99% chance of getting a glass half-empty, but you got a glass half-full. How lucky is that!
items.name: Major Luckster

items.description: That playground bully who destroyed your sand castle traumatised you for life. Time for payback.
items.name: Minor Fortification

items.description: That playground bully who destroyed your sand castle traumatised you for life. Time for payback.
items.name: Fortification

items.description: That playground bully who destroyed your sand castle traumatised you for life. Time for payback.
items.name: Major Fortification

items.description: Monsters will bite you on the bum and you will bite the dust. Poor monsters.
items.name: Minor Earth Devastator

items.description: Monsters will bite you on the bum and you will bite the dust. Poor monsters.
items.name: Earth Devastator

items.description: Monsters will bite you on the bum and you will bite the dust. Poor monsters.
items.name: Major Earth Devastator

items.description: There where your Dragoturkey has passed, the grass will never grow again.
items.name: Minor Neutral Devastator

items.description: There where your Dragoturkey has passed, the grass will never grow again.
items.name: Neutral Devastator

items.description: There where your Dragoturkey has passed, the grass will never grow again.
items.name: Major Neutral Devastator

items.description: When attacked, you'll fire back with anything: curses, taunts, bad jokes, baptisms and great balls.
items.name: Minor Fire Devastator

items.description: When attacked, you'll fire back with anything: curses, taunts, bad jokes, baptisms and great balls.
items.name: Fire Devastator

items.description: When attacked, you'll fire back with anything: curses, taunts, bad jokes, baptisms and great balls.
items.name: Major Fire Devastator

items.description: You've always strongly believed that blood is thicker than water. Which is why you never pour yourself a refreshing glass of blood.
items.name: Minor Water Devastator

items.description: You've always strongly believed that blood is thicker than water. Which is why you never pour yourself a refreshing glass of blood.
items.name: Water Devastator

items.description: You've always strongly believed that blood is thicker than water. Which is why you never pour yourself a refreshing glass of blood.
items.name: Major Water Devastator

items.description: You tried different air styles but that was before your thatch turned into thin air.
items.name: Minor Air Devastator

items.description: You tried different air styles but that was before your thatch turned into thin air.
items.name: Air Devastator

items.description: You tried different air styles but that was before your thatch turned into thin air.
items.name: Major Air Devastator

items.description: The Tanuks don't hit puberty for a few decades, but when they do they gain both their independence and a ferocious temper. Before adolescence they're as docile as a lazy Bow Meow, but it's impossible to tell the males from the females, since their distinguishing features, at this age, haven't grown much bigger than their tails. The poachers working in Pandala make a nice bit of money from the trafficking of these creatures, to which you are contributing by taking this little Tanuk under your wing.
items.name: Tanuk

items.description: Your technique is not to be the quickest, but to just delay everyone else so you're not the slowest. This is a tried and tested technique in all administrations of the World of Twelve.
items.name: Minor Delayer

items.description: Your technique is not to be the quickest, but to just delay everyone else so you're not the slowest. This is a tried and tested technique in all administrations of the World of Twelve.
items.name: Delayer

items.description: Although not quite as cute as a Konalak, you'll feel just as much need to take care of it, to cuddle it, to stroke its head and to rub your face against its soft fur.
items.name: Bloalak

items.description: Your technique is not to be the quickest, but to just delay everyone else so you're not the slowest. This is a tried and tested technique in all administrations of the World of Twelve.
items.name: Major Delayer

items.description: Headbutting an enemy to stun them seemed to be an interesting tactic. Until you realized they were wearing a helmet, but you weren't.
items.name: Minor Stunner

items.description: Headbutting an enemy to stun them seemed to be an interesting tactic. Until you realized they were wearing a helmet, but you weren't.
items.name: Stunner

items.description: Headbutting an enemy to stun them seemed to be an interesting tactic. Until you realized they were wearing a helmet, but you weren't.
items.name: Major Stunner

items.description: Use a good Fire attack with this Trophy and you'll be able to dodge and burn.
items.name: Minor Evader

items.description: Use a good Fire attack with this Trophy and you'll be able to dodge and burn.
items.name: Evader

items.description: Use a good Fire attack with this Trophy and you'll be able to dodge and burn.
items.name: Major Evader

items.description: The result of Doctor Morose's experiments, the Mastostroke was created by repeatedly crossing Angora Bow Meows with Evil Dandelions. Its mischievous character, inherited from its gene pool, has made it the target of much Iopery.
items.name: Mastostroke

items.description: There's no shame in fleeing when there's no chance of winning.
items.name: Minor Escapee

items.description: There's no shame in fleeing when there's no chance of winning.
items.name: Escapee

items.description: There's no shame in fleeing when there's no chance of winning.
items.name: Major Escapee

items.description: Knocking down so many enemies has made you a happy feller.
items.name: Minor Feller

items.description: Knocking down so many enemies has made you a happy feller.
items.name: Feller

items.description: Knocking down so many enemies has made you a happy feller.
items.name: Major Feller

items.description: Solid but not unbreakable. This is how your allies will describe you just before breaking your two big toes following a terrible joke.
items.name: Minor Solid

items.description: Solid but not unbreakable. This is how your allies will describe you just before breaking your two big toes following a terrible joke.
items.name: Solid

items.description: Solid but not unbreakable. This is how your allies will describe you just before breaking your two big toes following a terrible joke.
items.name: Major Solid

items.description: Sometimes it's just better to be never than late.
items.name: Minor Motivator

items.description: Sometimes it's just better to be never than late.
items.name: Motivator

items.description: Sometimes it's just better to be never than late.
items.name: Major Motivator

items.description: This Trophy may come in useful as a dirt dish. If used upside down, logic dictates that it could also be used to dish the dirt.
items.name: Minor Earth Carapace

items.description: This Trophy may come in useful as a dirt dish. If used upside down, logic dictates that it could also be used to dish the dirt.
items.name: Earth Carapace

items.description: This Trophy may come in useful as a dirt dish. If used upside down, logic dictates that it could also be used to dish the dirt.
items.name: Major Earth Carapace

items.description: This Trophy protects you from all the ditherers who can't choose sides during a fight.
items.name: Minor Neutral Carapace

items.description: This Trophy protects you from all the ditherers who can't choose sides during a fight.
items.name: Neutral Carapace

items.description: This Trophy protects you from all the ditherers who can't choose sides during a fight.
items.name: Major Neutral Carapace

items.description: This Trophy will make an excellent ashtray if you prefer to use the Peace Pipe rather than fight.
items.name: Minor Fire Carapace

items.description: This Trophy will make an excellent ashtray if you prefer to use the Peace Pipe rather than fight.
items.name: Fire Carapace

items.description: This Trophy will make an excellent ashtray if you prefer to use the Peace Pipe rather than fight.
items.name: Major Fire Carapace

items.description: This Trophy protects you from Crocodyl Tears.
items.name: Minor Water Carapace

items.description: This Trophy protects you from Crocodyl Tears.
items.name: Water Carapace

items.description: This Trophy protects you from Crocodyl Tears.
items.name: Major Water Carapace

items.description: Taking refuge under this Trophy will protect you from wind, but will not prevent you from generating your own. This can lead to an uncomfortable case of trapped wind.
items.name: Minor Air Carapace

items.description: Taking refuge under this Trophy will protect you from wind, but will not prevent you from generating your own. This can lead to an uncomfortable case of trapped wind.
items.name: Air Carapace

items.description: Taking refuge under this Trophy will protect you from wind, but will not prevent you from generating your own. This can lead to an uncomfortable case of trapped wind.
items.name: Major Air Carapace

items.description: You took it literally when she said to 'get up and go'.
items.name: Minor Vigour

items.description: You took it literally when she said to 'get up and go'.
items.name: Vigour

items.description: You took it literally when she said to 'get up and go'.
items.name: Major Vigour

items.description: This Trophy emits little electric shocks to keep you active. You can use it on your abs, in your underwear or in an aquarium, if you like to watch fish float.
items.name: Shaker

items.description: You like to call yourself a nomad. Which is really just a nicer way of describing a coward.
items.name: Nomad

items.description: Perched high up in a tree, far from the fight, and armed only with a telescope, observers often play a decisive role in a battle. Most importantly, they are the first to be able to flee when they detect the battle is turning against their allies.
items.name: Observer

items.description: Your friends salivate when they see you butcher but refuse to eat your delicious garlic soup. Strange.
items.name: Minor Bloodthirst

items.description: Your friends salivate when they see you butcher but refuse to eat your delicious garlic soup. Strange.
items.name: Bloodthirst

items.description: Your friends salivate when they see you butcher but refuse to eat your delicious garlic soup. Strange.
items.name: Major Bloodthirst

items.description: This rare paintbrush, made with Treechnidian wood and Moowolf hairs will help you entertain your friends.
items.name: Paintbrush

items.description: Now you can re-enact your favourite operas in the comfort of your own home!
items.name: Kardorim's Helmet

items.description: By wearing this cape, you can make the Incarnam Chafers think you're their captain. Too bad they don't have eyes to see it.
items.name: Kardorim's Cape

items.description: Made from Chafer bone, this magnificent bracelet will protect your wrist from sword blows looking to cut it, all while building your muscles. A very valuable item for beginners like you.
items.name: Kardorim's Bracelet

items.description: Thanks to the light coming from this headpiece, no one will be able to surprise you, which is a useful feature for walking around Incarnam in peace.
items.name: Phan Diadem

items.description: If you haven't got a lively spirit and a virtuous spirit, you can at least look like you do, thanks to these wings made from pure celestial matter.
items.name: Sykee Cape

items.description: The legend says that this amulet contains the soul of a powerful magician who challenged Ecaflip to a game of celestial belote – the favourite card game of the Twelve – and won. If you wear it around your neck while playing cards, maybe he'll make an appearance...
items.name: Animulette

items.description: You just have to hold this hammer to be overtaken by a sudden desire to break everything. There's a reason Hargnok is called the Smasher...
items.name: Hargnok's Hammer

items.description: An indispensable tool for collecting minerals.
items.name: Requisitioned Pick

items.description: This bag has long been popular in Incarnam. Lady adventurers find it as elegant as they do practical; gentleman adventurers use it to hold the detached teeth of their enemies.
items.name: Reinforced Handbag

items.description: If you're going to dig your own grave, you might as well use a shovel crafted by the Terra Cogita clan. At least that way you know you'll get a first-class burial.
items.name: Terra Clan Shovel

items.description: Decorated with Crocodyl teeth as sharp as a Sword of Iop, this belt will make you look like a seasoned old hunter that you'd rather not mess with.
items.name: Hunter Belt

items.description: "Tap dancing or butt kicking, the choice is yours!" You can finally say goodbye to this old dilemma, thanks to these marvelous boots that protect your feet without skipping a beat...ing.
items.name: Kokokoboots

items.description: Bontarians are fond of the Bontick's loyalty and devotion, although others find it a bit too clingy. Once it's decided it likes you, you'll be stuck together like glue and the bond it's formed will be unbreakable, no matter how hard you try. You'll never be alone, not even in the bathroom.
items.name: Bontick

items.description: Brakarinas are a real pain in the neck. After the extermination of Brakmar's Vilinsekts, they spread like a plague through the houses. You'll find them creepy crawling in your mattresses, carpets and household linens. Some Brakmarians like their cantankerous nature and keep them as pets.
items.name: Brakarina

items.description: The Kanniballs claim that the Moon's Tree is actually a sleeping dragon. The immortal being came down from the moon and took the form of a great Kokokonut tree to shade a princess from the blistering sun. Then he dozed off... So does that mean the Dokoko, fruit of the Moon's Tree, is a genuine Dofus? The jury's still out on that one.

effects.formatted:
The Monkey and the Moon:
• Every 3 turns starting on turn 3, the bearer regains 10% health.

items.name: Dokoko

items.description: Preferring music to hunting, Kanniball Tams use a mask with white hair instead of black to distinguish themselves from other members of their tribe, which gives them style beyond compare.
items.name: Tam Voodoo Mask

items.description: Moon found this magical hammer when he was captured by a Poacher pirate. In his hands, a single hammer strike to the ground is enough to cause an earthquake, which is especially handy when trying to shake down the Kokokonuts in the highest branches.
items.name: Moon Hammer

items.description: This cloak is made from Kokoko Leaves and Citronanas, which explains its exotic colours and undeniable charm. Unfortunately, it emits a less charming odour that attracts every kind of wild animal imaginable, who take you for a giant, delicious banana.
items.name: Moon Cloak

items.description: The Kanniballs fashioned this item with an image of Moon, who they consider the God-Monkey of the island. According to legend, it was a strike of the monkey hammer that gave it the shape of a crescent moon. At least, that's what the employees at Charlie's Agents tell travellers who come to spend their holidays on the island when they're trying to extort a few kamas for the amulet.
items.name: Moon Amulet

items.description: This sword's formidable power can strike your enemies with lightning. Please note that for best results, this technique should be attempted during a storm, when the sword is held towards the sky and when your enemies are holding the blade.
items.name: Celestial Swashbuckler Sword

items.description: The rope of this belt is made with an extremely rare material that absorbs lightning bolts and retains their energy. It's just the thing to protect you on stormy days when you can't find anywhere to take shelter.
items.name: Celestial Swashbuckler Belt

items.description: Legend has it that whoever wears the ‘Circle of Lightning' contained in this cloak will be able to control lightning. It might be nothing more than a legend, but it's worth a shot!
items.name: Celestial Swashbuckler Cloak

items.description: Ideal for disguising yourself as an old hermit, this beard will make you look like you've spent your whole life meditating in order to understand and master the mysteries of Pandawushu.
items.name: Zatoishwan's Beard

items.description: Adjusted for a large waist, this solid belt will help you get around more easily and reduce your efforts if you're carrying a few extra pounds. Conversely, you could always use it to tie up your most hefty enemies.
items.name: Zatoishwan's Belt

items.description: It is said that this staff lets its owner locate nearby sources of alcohol. It may just be superstitious nonsense, but it can't hurt to try!
items.name: Zatoishwan's Staff

items.description: It is said that Voldelor locked up part of his soul in this amulet. Maybe Larry Poller knows more about it.
items.name: Voldelor Amulet

items.description: This belt is a mark of membership in the Breatheater brotherhood. They say it's what lets them digest all the gold they ingest.
items.name: Voldelor Belt

items.description: Voldelor hasn't worn his boots since he learned to levitate. But he developed a weakness that fateful day: ticklishness.
items.name: Voldelor Boots

items.description: Though Kongoku hide makes a top-quality fabric, wearing this cloak could be particularly dangerous if you have an unfortunate run-in with an animal rights activist.
items.name: Kongoku Cloak

items.description: This somewhat rebellious earring has an annoying tendency to change from the right ear to the left ear depending on which direction its wearer is looking.
items.name: Kongoku Earring

items.description: Actually, Kongoku wears this belt on his wrists, which speaks volumes about the monster's girth.
items.name: Kongoku Belt

items.description: This cloak once belonged to LeChouque, the most famous pirate to have ever sailed the seas of Amakna if he does say so himself (and he does). They said that the pirate and his crew were doomed to live out their days as ghosts and skeletons after their ship fell victim to a mysterious curse.
items.name: Pirate Captain's Cloak

items.description: Much more chic than a plumed hat, this pirate hat will tell you where all sorts of treasure in hidden on the high seas of Amakna. Unfortunately, you'll be the only one who can hear its voice, so everyone else will just think you're not rowing with both oars, if you catch my drift.
items.name: Pirate Captain's Hat

items.description: This magical wedding ring, which was found in an ancestral treasure, has the power to change the colour of its wearer's pee. Too bad it's not especially useful at sea...
items.name: Pirate Captain's Wedding Ring

items.description: The Warrior of KOs wore this belt to show everyone he was the KO Champion. Now that it belongs to you, it's your turn to show off!
items.name: KOs' Belt

items.description: According to legend, this amulet is supposed to protect its wearer from all sorts of possible death scenarios. But considering what you did to its last owner, it's probably just a false rumour.
items.name: KOs' Amulet

items.description: Crushing, squeezing, breaking, stamping, grinding... Those are just some of the things these boots are made for, besides walking.
items.name: KOs' Boots

items.description: These size 2 waders were made for Ecaflips with small feet. Unless you share a shoe size with Kerub, they'll make a lovely decoration for your living room.
items.name: 1001 Claws Boots

items.description: This marvellous piece of armour is an exact replica of the breeches worn by Kerub. It will stop any enemy weapons heading cruelly towards your intimate areas.
items.name: 1001 Claws Breeches

items.description: These boots are the cause of your favourite team's speediness, and are just as useful for racing to victory as fleeing from a thrashing.
items.name: Bigoks Boots

items.description: These racing boots are prickly as a rose and will help you cover great distances both horizontally and vertically, thanks to the spikes fastened securely to the front.
items.name: Redroz Boots

items.description: ‘It's a bird... It's a plane... No, it's a Pamu!' is the slogan that every loyal Pamus supporter yells when a member of their team scores.
items.name: Pamus Boots

items.description: Running swifter than the swiftest wild animals, Zalblaks owe part of their fame to these splendid boots, made especially for racing.
items.name: Zalblaks Boots

items.description: This belt, which bears a picture of the reward earned by the Gobbowl World Cup winners, will let you gloat excessively to the other teams' supporters by giving you an air of superiority and snobbery.
items.name: Bigoks Belt

items.description: This belt, which protects its wearer's intimate parts, was designed specifically for Redroz supporters, since they're known for starting brawls in Gobbowl stadiums.
items.name: Redroz Belt

items.description: This belt falls somewhere between a kilt and a championship belt. It has been worn by countless generations of Pamus supporters. Honour your team and be the next in line!
items.name: Pamus Belt

items.description: These skin-tight shorts will make you look like a strong athlete with an untamed spirit, ready to jump on anything that moves. Just like a real Zalblak!
items.name: Zalblaks Belt

items.description: The Groogler is one of the most curious animals in all the World of Twelve. Its bulging eyes and flat face give it a particularly ridiculous appearance, while its spiky crest and ample tail evoke a ferocious beast. So many contradictions in such a little creature...
items.name: Groogler

items.description: Emanating a chromatic light with sumptuous colours, this headdress reacts to its wearer's power by modulating the intensity of its glow.
items.name: Fundamental Headdress

items.description: Traditionally worn during ceremonies and journeys, this cape is imbued with a powerful magic that gives its wearer incredible charisma, a heroic attitude, and foolproof protection against the rain and mud chips.

effects.formatted: Astral Blade: line of sight off
Sun Lance: line of sight off

items.name: Fundamental Cape

items.description: With these boots on your feet, you'll always be first at everything, from going off on an adventure to fleeing from a fight.
items.name: Initial Boots

items.description: Created to catalyse the energy of the Quadramental Breeze, this belt is the first piece of the traditional Huppermage tunic to be created. The style and colours were largely inspired by Bonta's, where its creator, The legendary Huppermage Ouatsonne, is from.
items.name: The Elebelt

items.description: Forged in Huppermage fire, this ring of power is full of mystery. Inside, there's an inscription that reads: "Fire wets, water burns, and all piwis fly in the sky." What does it mean? Your guess is as good as anyone's.
items.name: Oringinal

items.description: You'll be pining for these shoes once you realise how great they are.
items.name: Piney Shoes

items.description: Whether you put this ring on your finger or on a Kwismas Tree, it's the ideal accessory to be displayed during the festive season.
items.name: Kwismas Ring

items.description: This magic wand has an enchantment which lets it open a passage to the Dark Hornbeam Wood. It would be much more popular if it opened a passage to the tavern.
items.name: Bony Wand

items.description: Inspire terror among your adversaries by wearing this necklace in the form of a skull, the symbol of strength and brutality. If Khan does it, it must mean it works!
items.name: Khan Karkass's Necklace

items.description: Many Bontarians think that the Monarch's beard is made of gold, but it's really just his Torque riding up a bit.
items.name: Monarch Torque

items.description: Avoid wearing these boots if you're planning on trying out for a Gobbowl Ball team. You might end up flailing around lamentably.
items.name: Marline's Boots

items.description: Gold like the sun, these shiny boots blind all the King's loyal followers who kneel at his feet.
items.name: Monarch Boots

items.description: Wearing these briefs won't make you a Gobbowl champion, but they'll sure show off your goods.
items.name: Khan Karkass's Briefs

items.description: If this belt is big, it's only to contain all the extra weight the King of Bonta has put on during his reign. At least you won't feel restricted in it!
items.name: Monarch Belt

items.description: Worn as a necklace by very large beings, this torque is the main piece of Kerub's armour, protecting his entire upper torso.
items.name: 1001 Claws Torque

items.description: As the King's close guard, you must be prepared for any eventuality. Even getting hit in your sensitive bits.
items.name: Royal Guard Belt

items.description: The wings on these boots are the symbol of the city you protect, but also a reminder of the Bonta guard's oath: "Go, run, fly and flee."
items.name: Royal Guard Boots

items.description: A very fashionable accessory, this necklace set with small gold-plated bones will be all the rage, especially if you go walking in the Sidimote Moors.
items.name: Lilotte's Necklace

items.description: Unfortunately, heartfelt kisses aren't enough to keep your Minikron fed.
items.name: Minikron

items.description: This magnificent pair of boots will make you a wee bit smarter.
items.name: Fecaflip

items.description: This wonderful bouquet will show your beloved that you're ready to brave a thousand and one dangers for their sweet little face.
items.name: Bouquet of Demonic Roses

items.description: The clubs on these boots are scented, and can therefore be placed on the inside, in order to avoid certain unpleasant odours, or to be combined with said odours to create something unique and unpredictable.
items.name: King Playa Boots

items.description: The few serious topics that reach the King Playa's ears go over his head, and therefore arrive at this headpiece. Over time, it has thus become burdened with the weight of seriousness. This gravity may explain how the golden rings surrounding it are kept in place, but also why it doesn't move when you do an about-turn.
items.name: King Playa Crown

items.description: King Playa uses his Signet Ring to mark his victims. Now where could the wax that he uses for that come from...?
items.name: King Playa Signet Ring

items.description: These comfortable slippers leave impressive paw prints behind them. They must be handled with caution, as they can attract massive canine monsters such as Moowolves.
items.name: Queen of Fate Boots

items.description: Inside this pendant is a portrait of the person you love the most. In other words, yourself.
items.name: Queen of Fate Necklace

items.description:
There's an inscription inside this cape:
"Whoever stole this cape must return it to me, and OFF WITH THEIR HEAD!
xoxo, your Queen."
items.name: Queen of Fate Cape

items.description: These boots were made specifically for moving between tiles. However, they'll be of no use to you in a labyrinth, for example.
items.name: Catseye Boots

items.description: This Helmet will make you look much more serious.
items.name: Catseye Helmet

items.description: A six-pack on your back not being of any real use, this cape can be used as an apron.
items.name: Catseye Cape

items.description: Don't forget to write your and your master's names on this collar. If you get lost, it could prove necessary so you can be given back to the right person.
items.name: Jammy Jack Collar

items.description: If these gloves look like they have only enough room for three of your fingers, that actually is the case. All that's left to do is curse the tailor who made them, or to cut off two of your fingers.
items.name: Jammy Jack Glove

items.description: Have you always dreamt of having four tails? Then here you go!
items.name: Jammy Jack Cape

items.description: This cape can be split in two. Each half can then be used as a semi-cape. Impressive, huh?
items.name: Atcham Cape

items.description: These sandals are also used as slideskates, letting you slide across certain surfaces as if you were wearing nothing more than socks. Wearing socks with these sandals does not increase the sliding effect.
items.name: Atcham Sandals

items.description: These sabres are very sharp – so much so that if Atcham had any hair, he'd have a hard time holding them without slicing off his fur.
items.name: Atcham Sabres

items.description: There are few materials as resistant as the fabric used to make this collar, which will protect you from any sword blows that might be aimed at your neck...
items.name: Ush's Collar

items.description: These boots are as comfortable as slippers when they're on your feet, and as hard as rock when worn to protect certain more sensitive bits.
items.name: Ush Boots

items.description: Each of Ush's swords represents a part of himself. This one represents his flamboyant side, so you'll be leaving him with only his darker, serious side.
items.name: Ush's Sword

items.description: With its tiger-striped motif, the Weremoggy Cape will let you scramble your opponent's vision so completely they'll be effectively blind.
items.name: Weremoggy Cape

items.description: You thought you'd be able to blend in with the Weremoggies by wearing their symbol around your waist, but this cat's head is actually used to mark their next target. Too bad for you.
items.name: Weremoggy Belt

items.description: This ring has the strange characteristic of making its wearer's phrases start with the phrase "Zounds!". However, it doesn't seem to work on you. Maybe it's just an old legend...
items.name: Weremoggy Ring

items.description: When you walk with these boots, each step causes an annoying little metallic sound, as if they were made of steel.
items.name: Colousses Boots

items.description: Like a champion's belt, Colousses's Belt shows the world which of you two won out in your battle against this immense creature.
items.name: Colousses Belt

items.description: This scalp is created from hairs from Colousses's skull, and it's particularly hideous, but at least you'll have some hair handy in case of any sudden baldness.
items.name: Colousses Scalp

items.description: Only an exceptional jeweller could have conceived such a marvel, made with unparalleled attention to detail and exceptional attention to minutia.
items.name: Ecaflee Ring

items.description: Worn on a necklace, this Bytbul will bring you luck in the most disastrous situations.
items.name: Ecaflee Collar

items.description: Give the Melouse a hiding and make yourself a Melcape!
items.name: Ecaflee Cape

items.description: Don't forget that in equipping this shield, you're supporting science. Here's hoping you don't end up regretting it.
items.name: Experimental Foam Shield

items.description: What's white, smells really bad, and keeps you warm in winter? No, it's not a dead Wabbit wrapped around your neck. Will you ever stop saying silly things?
items.name: Experimental Wool Shield

items.description: The origin of the elastic green material covering this shield is very mysterious. The only thing we know is that the Goblins consider it sacred.
items.name: Experimental Trud Shield

items.description: Upon receiving, possibly painfully, an arrow from this bow, the message is obvious: someone's spotted you.
items.name: Catseye Bow

items.description: This sceptre would have made King Nidas lose his mind during a high-stakes card game.
items.name: King Playa's Scepta

items.description: The three-die-face on this axe forms a passage between you and your victim, allowing for the exchange of material, sometimes living.
items.name: Catseye Axe

items.description: With this device on your head, you'll be able to see things that no one else can. And when they say that it causes hallucinations, well... you crossed that bridge a long time ago!
items.name: Improbability Magnifier

items.description: More agile than a Tofu at dinner time, the Maulleycat surprises its prey with its extreme speed, which makes it an exceptional predator, and also uncatchable. It's said that anyone that can tame the beast while naked will acquire its speed.
items.name: Maulleycat

items.description: The rockets installed on these boots can have two entirely different purposes: either they allow you to snatch a narrow victory thanks to the acceleration they provide, or they will transform your Dragoturkey into roast meat if you lose the race.
items.name: Dragorace Boots

items.description: In an accident, this belt will protect you from injuries just as much as a set of your briefs worn as a helmet would.
items.name: Dragorace Belt

items.description: Generally causing onomatopaeic spasms and hot flashes among lovers of cute things, Kerubabies are adorable little Kikitties raised in the Ecaflipus Dimension. Nobody knows if the magical aura that resides there is the reason they look like Kerub.
items.name: Kerubaby

items.description: It's heresy to use this hammer for anything other than advancing science. Smashing enemies' skulls can be classed in this category if it's done with a scientific goal.
items.name: Ereziah's Hammer

items.description: Straight from the Depths of Sufokia, this Glub owes its name to the sounds it makes when you pull it out of an underwater cavity – its natural habitat. Its cuddly side and its funny shape make it Trituns' best friend.
items.name: Glub

items.description: Ratchams are often mistaken for rats, due to their tail, long ears and lack of bodily hair. But if you adopt one, you'll soon find out how little this pawed predator has in common with a rodent. As cuddly as they come, it'll lick your face, and you'll discover that no, Ratchams are not completely lacking in hair.
items.name: Ratcham

items.description: To make the most of summer, why not show off your feet? They're just asking to get a tan!
items.name: Seasandals
