items.description: Although they prefer not to talk about it, a legend claims that Raval, protector of the month of Septangel, once demanded that the Centoror people pay a tribute of a thousand billion nuggets in exchange for the head of their fallen hero Menalt. A heavy debt indeed, but one that they seem determined to pay back...
items.name: Pp Chests

items.description: Although they prefer not to talk about it, a legend claims that Raval, protector of the month of Septangel, once demanded that the Centoror people pay a tribute of a thousand billion nuggets in exchange for the head of their fallen hero Menalt. A heavy debt indeed, but one that they seem determined to pay back...
items.name: Ap Ga Chests

items.description: Although they prefer not to talk about it, a legend claims that Raval, protector of the month of Septangel, once demanded that the Centoror people pay a tribute of a thousand billion nuggets in exchange for the head of their fallen hero Menalt. A heavy debt indeed, but one that they seem determined to pay back...
items.name: Ini Chests

items.description: Perceptors can carry such an incredible number of items around in them that certain scholars have hypothesised that their traditional bags are actually haven bags. Do you suppose they have furniture and decorations in there too?
items.name: Pod Bags

items.description: Perceptors can carry such an incredible number of items around in them that certain scholars have hypothesised that their traditional bags are actually haven bags. Do you suppose they have furniture and decorations in there too?
items.name: Mp Ga Bags

items.description: Perceptors can carry such an incredible number of items around in them that certain scholars have hypothesised that their traditional bags are actually haven bags. Do you suppose they have furniture and decorations in there too?
items.name: Range Bags

items.description: Invented by a crafter whose ears were constantly buzzing, this weapon is effective not only against moskitos, but anyone who needs a swat.
items.name: Moskito Swatter

items.description: Once carried by Solar, the Menologium lets you not only deal with pressing matters, but it also manage the cycle of the seasons, which can be handy when dealing with climatic disturbances, temporal anomalies and time-consuming larvae. Oh, and it's also the best way to shield yourself from the hammer attacks of angry Protectors.
items.name: Menologium

items.description: When you're preparing to confront a force of nature corrupted by an eliocalyptic power, a divine blessing is every bit as important as caramel sauce on your vanilla ice cream: strictly indispensable.
items.name: Blessed Menologium

items.description: This Dofus was born of a promise made long ago, before the seasons laid the rhythm to the world's dance through the void. Will you show yourself worthy of carrying it?
items.name: Sylvan Dofus

items.description: To heal an immortal consumed by corruption, nothing beats the power of a goddess combined with the power of a Dofus in the hands of an egg-collecting adventurer.
items.name: Verdant Dofus

items.description: The sacrificial fruit sows the seeds of renewal. Whether painful metamorphosis, natural healing, or a simple passage of time, the end of an interminable winter is always a miracle.

effects.formatted:
Country Ranger:
• The bearer gains 8 Power for 2 turns for each MP they use.
• If the bearer doesn't use any MP during their turn, they are healed for 8% of their health.

items.name: Sylvan Dofus

items.description: An old legend told by historians of the Third Age claims that Mamukils used to have four tusks. Fascinating truth, or just a fable for children and fools who can't count past two? Let the scholars fight it out in the arenas of the Kolossium.
items.name: Mamukil Kolophant

items.description: After leading his troops across a river, the Great Lexander defeated King Sporo and stole his kolophants. These massive creatures were not only much more intelligent than dragoturkeys – their eyes also consistently pointed in the same direction. With war mounts like these, Lexander was ready to conquer the World of Ten! But alas, his time ran out too soon, as he fell victim to a severe fever three years later. It turns out that tiny creatures invisible to the naked eye can be every bit as deadly as kolophants.
items.name: Lexander's Kolophant

items.description: The fur covering the kolophants of Tarkaj is not natural. In fact, it's a thick mastostroke pelt cut to size. This hirsute blanket was created on the orders of Kanigal, a brilliant tactician in ancient times. It seemed that the general wanted to cross a mountain range with his army. His mastodons were sure-footed, but highly sensitive to cold. So Kanigal found a solution that enabled him to literally crush his enemies. When it comes to winning in battle, military genius knows no bounds.
items.name: Tarkaj Kolophant

items.description: In the inns of Madrestam, drinkers tell tales of a gigantic Zenusha wandering the seas with an island on its back. Its legs are so long that it doesn't need to swim. It feels along the ocean floor with its trunk. But what is it searching for? The pirate king's crown? A long-submerged chest? To find a treasure hidden that far beneath the waves, this kolophant would have to get incredibly lucky.
items.name: Zenusha Kolophant

items.description: Often used by scouts patrolling the edges of the swamp, this agile reptile is more ferocious than a crocodyl with a toothache. Tenacious and sneaky, it's not afraid of a fight... but it can also slip away like an eel, only to come back and finish the job when you're least expecting it.
items.name: Ziplizard

items.description: Have a hard time taking the initiative? Climb on this imposing snake's back, and your wallflower days will be a thing of the past! And don't be afraid that this mount will slow you down: the kobrapid is living proof that a well-styled head is more important than having legs.
items.name: Kobrapid

items.description: As an extraordinary bird once said, "To fly as fast as thought, to anywhere that is, you must begin by knowing that you have already arrived." The truly spiritual words of a soul that refused to be weighed down by convention or taboo. Maybe that's why you feel as light as a feather when riding on your Kwismas gull.
items.name: Kwismas Gull

items.description: Often seen on the arms of Bontarian soldiers, this shield is instantly recognisable by its fine detailing, the quality of its wood, its perfect curves, its... Oh... hang on... Sorry, this one's just an especially good replica. The artisan who crafted it must have been blessed by Jember.
items.name: Tonbarian Shield

items.description:
"Good kings are slaves, and their people are free."

— Allister, King of Amakna
items.name: Allister's Aegis

items.description: With this Dofus granted by the guardians of Ankama, you can say "I was there!" and enjoy the fun side of nostalgia without feeling too old. See you again in twenty years?
items.name: Aiwuztheya Dofus

items.description: You can never be too careful, unless it stops you from making a single choice in life.
items.name: Cautious

items.description: Fortune favours the bold... and those who have this trophy. Don't use it to visit the casino – you know how well that turned out last time.
items.name: Audacious

items.description: This trophy will greatly increase your impetuous nature and youthful hotheadedness. But your parents can rest assured – your responsibilities and time's unstoppable march will soon take their toll on your energy and zest for life.
items.name: Impetuous

items.description: This trophy is all about sharing. Sure, you're going to take things, but just imagine what you're going to give back! You've got to love a good fight.
items.name: Pugilist

items.description: This trophy is ideal if you want to pretend to be a sorcerer, as it will reveal the most secretive mysteries of magic. But first, perhaps you should learn how to cast a Leek Pie the right way.
items.name: Arcanist

items.description: Just like the famous Ronan, this trophy will turn you into a true barbarian. Obviously, you'll lose a few brain cells in the process.
items.name: Barbaric

items.description: This genuine prespic-hair shield bristles when enemies are around. It's a handy deterrent for even the most daring of them. If they get too close, they'll find themselves in a prickly situation!
items.name: Spiky Prespic Shield

items.description: You may not have realised it, but the Ponym shield is named after the equally renowned e-ponym-ous Ponym shield.
items.name: Ponym Shield

items.description:
Under bleak skies as embers rise
The beetle's steeled shell lies sealed
In shadowy realms where whispers dwell
items.name: Onance Carapace

items.description: Carrying this real horned shield, you'll feel like a fierce yet noble beast, ready to charge at your opponents to defend your territory! Just be careful not to go charging headfirst into a wall, because the horns will stay stuck in it.
items.name: Royal Mastogob Ram

items.description: Make Bonta proud by wearing this gobbowl shield in the city's colours. Let the match begin, and may the best side win!
items.name: Bontarian Gobbowler Shield

items.description: Make Brakmar proud by wearing this gobbowl shield in the city's colours. Let the match begin, and may the best side win!
items.name: Brakmarian Gobbowler Shield

items.description: This royal cuirass will give you power over the gobballs in Tainela. But be careful, as the crown is greatly coveted, and while this shield will protect you from poutches, it definitely won't protect you from putsches.
items.name: Royal Gobball Cuirass

items.description: If you prefer something crunchy instead of tough, well... you're in for a treat with this shield. Like many a Cra rookie in the Kolossium, it's bound to crumble to pieces at the first sign of trouble.
items.name: Crispy Targe

items.description:
"Humanity cannot obtain anything without giving something in return. For every single thing received, another of equal value must be given up."

— Otomai, Renowned Alchemist
items.name: Otomai's Vial

items.description:
"Ruling means making it so your subjects cannot harm you... or even think about it."

— Danathor, Steward of Bonta
items.name: Danathor's Escutcheon

items.description: This shield is said to have been handed down by a highly influential guild, the first one to rise to prominence during the resurgence ushered in by King Allister.
items.name: Blanckler

items.description: Maduras are dangerous creatures that can bond with other Yokai to protect them. Some of their power resides within this shield, but since you find it so hard to form lasting bonds, you won't benefit from its full potential.
items.name: Madura Pupil

items.description: The studious Virgil knows every nook and cranny of Lord Crow's mazelike library, from every secret passage to every staircase, and maybe even every book... Unfortunately for you, this information is stored away in his memory, not on his lectern. Besides, you wouldn't have had the patience to go through such a wealth of knowledge.
items.name: Virgil's Lectern

items.description: If you're stopping by the Astrub zaap for the first time, pay no attention to the rumours spread by a number of facetious adventurers, because there isn't any special technique to magically earn kamas... Shock! Horror! How will you go on? It's simply outrageous! Are you having trouble breathing now? Then this shield will be perfect for you to use as a fan.
items.name: Halt Efkat

items.description: You've become a real boune, and it's all thanks to this sword! You'll be so proud of it, just like a boune would be.
items.name: Bounihime

items.description: This knife is the typical hallmark of the hunter. The brighter, sharper and bigger such blades are, the better-looking the hunters are... according to them, at least... A hunter equipped with this sharpened weapon will be able to take the best cuts from the carcasses of their prey.
items.name: Frank B. Nhin Hunting Knife

items.description: Captain Chafer may have been the worst kind of eccentric character, but he was also a one-of-a-kind fighter. Between his skill with daggers, his unrivalled cunning and his famous wedgie of darkness, many a rival of his has had their backside kicked.
items.name: Captain Chafer's Daggers

items.description:
"Good ol' Captain Chafer
wore his briefs the right way 'round,
and so Great Hogmeiser said,
with a disapproving frown,
'Why, Your Majesty,
you are rather misclad, I see.'
'That's true,' said the Captain,
'I'll turn them inside out right now.'"
items.name: Captain Chafer's Briefs

items.description: Don't be fooled by the patched-up, mouldy appearance of these boots, because they belonged to the legendary Captain Chafer. His good friend Hogmeiser, the founder of the Order of the Kicked Ass, made them for him back in the day so that he could dance the tango every night without faltering. These boots will most likely bring out your worst eccentricities and perversions, so you can either get rid of them quickly or join the party!
items.name: Captain Chafer's Boots

items.description: Hidden amongst the heights of the Cania Massif, the Imp Village is really hard to get to. But Mama Ayuto and her clever little protégés have developed this strange item, the parasail. By harnessing the strong winds that sweep across Cania and the warm air currents that flow up the mountainsides, this hang-gliding shield enables the Lost Children to remain completely elusive.
items.name: Mama Ayuto's Parasail

items.description: This gigantic rolling pin requires colossal strength to even lift it, but that's no problem for Mama Ayuto. They say that being hit by this weapon is like being struck by lightning and crushed by a mountain at the same time. It can also be used to make delicious sweet treats for children.
items.name: Mama Ayuto's Rolling Pin

items.description: According to a somewhat far-fetched legend, Mama Ayuto is one of Maimane's totems – Maimane being the founder of the Imp Village – who came to life to care for the orphans of the War of the Cities. Another far more plausible rumour is that she was once a member of the "Four", powerful witches who watched over the cardinal regions of Amakna, with Ayuto being the Guardian of the North. Could that explain Imp children's everlasting youthfulness? It's a mystery...
items.name: Mama Ayuto's Bandana

items.description:
"Vile intruder... You're still alive, it seems.
My dear, did you grant this miserable insect the honour of a victory?
No matter. Those blessed by the grace of the Twelve shall all meet death, in the embrace of Dark Vlad's flame!"
items.name: Dark Vlad's Flamberge

items.description: Before you put on this blood-and-sulphur-soaked tabard, make sure you really want to, because a fragment of the Incandescent One's soul may still reside within it.
items.name: Dark Vlad's Tabard

items.description: When you meet Dark Vlad somewhere along your way, it's best to run for your life and pray he doesn't catch you, or you'll end up like a grilled sausage.
items.name: Dark Vlad's Collar

items.description:
Inside this wedding ring, you can make out an inscription engraved by a metal tip and the fire of passion: Hell Mina + Dark Vlad = <3.

Now there's a relationship that will send sparks flying!
items.name: Dark Vlad's Ring

items.description: Just like the cheeken toys everyone loves so much that make screeching sounds, this Kideebom mace makes a whale's cry when you press it. It's just what you need to keep a child – or a Iop – entertained for hours on end.
items.name: Macetacean

items.description: Despite its dumbfounded expression and its phobia of needles, the gobbtrool isn't as fragile as it looks. Regular visits to the Gladiatrool Arena would certainly toughen anyone up, so when it comes to toughness, a gobbowl ball's got nothing on this aggressive pet.
items.name: White Gobbtrool

items.description: Have you always wanted to oversee others and give orders in Kabombz? Then you'll make a brilliant Bzzegg Supervisor.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor's Helmet

items.description: With this carapace, you can really take flight.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor's Winged Shell

items.description: With this shield, you're practically a tank.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor's Armour-Plating

items.description: Sometimes to turn down the heat, you need to hit 'em with the stinger.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor's Stinger

items.description: The Bzzegg Supervisor floats like a flutterpet and stings like a Kabombz.
items.name: Bzzegg Supervisor's Fist

items.description: Some see this as a sacred trophy. Others, an enchanted mop. Regardless, it smells of victory... and something else.
items.name: The Ripper's Mane

items.description: It was fashioned with the skull of an ancient oddnivore, a species known for their hard-headedness. That seems to have been literally true.
items.name: The Ripper's Trophy

items.description: This weapon was assembled in a hurry from what was left of the Ripper: one very large bone and one very bad idea. The result: it cuts poorly, but powerfully.
items.name: The Ripper's Cleaver

items.description: Each claw is at least 10 times sharper than the last, or even more so.
items.name: The Ripper's Claws

items.description: You can feel it in your bones – the Bony Mace is what you need.
items.name: Bony Mace

items.description: A sacred necklace that'll have you seeing red.
items.name: Rhoarim Necklace

items.description: It may not give you a majestic mane or natural authority... but at least it'll keep you warm.
items.name: Rhoarim Loincloth

items.description: Sometimes a hunter has to go feral to take down their prey.
items.name: Feral Scythe

items.description: Used to draw out prey in hiding and give them a good hiding.
items.name: Oddnicall

items.description: There's nothing too odd about these boots, which are popular with hunters and Osamodas. Except maybe the smell, but that's on you.
items.name: Oddniboots

items.description: If you hope to climb atop Gargandyas or get on the creatures living on his back, you'll absolutely need an Oddnivarness.
items.name: Oddnivarness

items.description: When it comes to being a Voyager, you'll want to buckle up. Or in this case, buckler up.
items.name: Voyager Shield

items.description:
"In the eyes of a Voyager,
The unsuspecting stranger
had better know the truth of wrong from right.
'Cause the eyes of a Voyager are upon you.
Any wrong you do, he's gonna see.
When you're in Cania,
Look behind you,
'cause that's where the Voyager's gonna be."
— A regular Voyager in Cania
items.name: Voyager Hood

items.description:
"Now you're
thinking with
portals..."
— A common catchphrase among Dimensional Voyagers
items.name: Voyager Portal

items.description: This'll fit you like a glove.
items.name: Voyager Glove

items.description: With these Voyager-inspired boots, your enemies will be quaking in theirs.
items.name: Voyager Boots

items.description:
This belt is fitted with scroll-rings. One scroll reads, simply:
"There's coffee in that nebula."
items.name: Voyager Belt

items.description: Not just a weapon, but an intention. Rather than to aim, it is drawn to conclude.
items.name: Nevark Bow

items.description: Protects the head, clouds the mind and attracts seagulls.
items.name: Oktapodas Helm

items.description: Bzbz ownbz wzllbz, kzllbz allbz monzzzrbz znbz wabz.
items.name: Znzzkzoklavzbz

items.description: Too heavy to wield; too dangerous to ignore. But have you seen this thing? Who needs finesse when you've got a 20-foot claw?
items.name: Gargandyas's Claw

items.description: This hammer is what remains of the titan Gargandyas. How powerful is it? Enough to make a Iop think... twice, even.
items.name: Gargandyas's Fury

items.description: This imposing shield has been hardened by time and rage. Carrying it will grant you incredible protection – assuming you can lift it.
items.name: Gargandyas's Ram

items.description: A symbol of Osamodas's domination, Gargandyas's necklace has stored up incredible power by containing the Titan's power for millennia.
items.name: Gargandyas's Necklace

items.description: A wind instrument or a blunt weapon? One thing's for sure: when the Horn is played, the Hunt is on.
items.name: Hunting Horn

items.description: Some tools are cutting, while others are explosive. Kabombz get to have both qualities in one.
items.name: Kabombz Daggers

items.description: This loincloth won't protect your private parts in the event of an explosion.
items.name: Kabombz Loincloth

items.description: They say you shouldn't put all your eggs in one basket... but no one ever told you about bzzeggs.
items.name: Bzzegg Basket

items.description:
"Nzkzbz bzzzkkbz. Zpzkzalbz bzzzkkbz. Almozzbz drakonbz bzzzkkbz!"

— Qzzznbz Alzkzabz

effects.formatted:
Explosive Hatching:
• When one of the bearer's summons is attacked, the bearer gains 1% final damage for 2 turns (stackable 10 times).
• If it is killed by an enemy, the bearer inflicts 10 damage in their best element on enemies in a 2-cell circle around the summons.

items.name: Dofzzbz

items.description: The Oddnivore horn shield is sturdy, impressive... and utterly useless if you need to run from a fight. It weighs half a tonne and will occasionally go straight on.
items.name: Oddnishield

items.description: Could a hundred Twelvians beat a single giant monkey? Apparently so.
items.name: Sleeping Venerable One's Coat

items.description: Huge horns, thick fur and a musky odour: everything you need to remind your enemies that a very cross giant monkey wore this headgear before you did.
items.name: Sleeping Venerable One's Horns

items.description: An ambition held captive by its instincts. Once worn by a noble spirit seeking glory, it is now saddled with an ancient burden.
items.name: Sleeping Venerable One's Curse

items.description:
A nocturnal coven causes the woods to stir,
A hasty procession pursues the beast,
An arrow is loosed, the spirits hold their breath,
The creature falls, the Hunter is victorious
He knows not yet the price of praise
The sound of horns and trumpets
Sing his triumph and his defeat
items.name: Sleeping Venerable One's Bow

items.description: Kobz nzmbzrbz zwobz? Zhzzbz hammzrbz nzmbzrbz onzbz.
items.name: Droppznkbz Hornbz

items.description: This little oddnipup is super cute, but be careful when feeding it, as it has indigestion.
items.name: Oddnipup

items.description: This tiny Krosmoglob will now follow you around, no doubt affectionately. Unless it's keeping an eye on you.
items.name: Mikrosmoglob

items.description: The Sleeping Venerable One's legendary mount has toughness, endurance and an utter disregard for your commands. It also won't tolerate being saddled. So you'll have to ride it bareback... if you dare.
items.name: The Venerable One's Mount

items.description:
"The advantage when you run a city like Brakmar is that no one's surprised when certain individuals disappear without warning. It's such a joy being able to give in to one's urges without having to justify one's actions. In any case, anyone who dares stand up to me will end up in the heart of the volcano in two shakes."

— Oto Mustam

effects.formatted:
Ardour of the Dark City:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer and their allies gain 1% final damage for 1 turn for each enemy fighter alive (stackable 4 times).

items.name: Oto Mustam's Ardour

items.description:
"You've met with a terrible fate, haven't you?"

— The Prisoner of the Mirror

effects.formatted:
Blinding Reflection:
• The bearer reduces and reflects 75% of initial damage from the first allied attack suffered onto the enemy closest to them in their line of sight (once per turn).
• At the end of each turn, the bearer removes 4 Range from all enemies in their line of sight for 1 turn and reveals them if they are Invisible (stackable 1 time).

items.name: Mirror Shield

items.description:
"Here we will stand and fight. There will be no more retreats. We are the Valiant Hearts, proud members of the Order of Thunder, the spearheads of glorious Bonta! We are going to stay and fight. And if we cannot stay here alive, we shall stay here dead!"

— Menalt, Protector of Martalo and Head of the Order of the Valiant Heart

effects.formatted:
Order of Thunder:
• At the end of each turn, the bearer gives 1 MP and 40 Pushback Damage to all allies in their line of sight for 1 turn (stackable 1 time).
• When an allied fighter dies, the bearer increases the final damage of all others by 4% until the end of the fight (stackable 2 times).
• The effects are removed when the bearer dies.

items.name: Menalt's Lightning Spear

items.description:
"There is no need to bow before me. When you are face to face with death, there is no more protocol, hypocrisy or lies. Only the truth remains. Naked, cruel, harrowing... and liberating."

— Thanatena, Queen of Externam

effects.formatted:
Thanatena's Judgement:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer erodes and increases damage suffered by everyone by 4% for 1 turn (stackable 1 time).
• When they finish off an enemy, they are healed for 20% of their health and gain 10% final damage for 1 turn. Healing is 5% of their health if it is a summons.

items.name: Thanatena's Judgement

items.description:
"Oh my love, how I long to embrace you! My recent adventures have been exhausting, and a break would do me a world of good. It will also be lovely to meet your dragon friend! I can picture the two of you fighting like children, which amuses me so.
See you soon. Your adoring Sephine."

— Helsephine, Iop Magician and Alchemist

effects.formatted:
Helsephine's Love:
• When the bearer applies shield or inflicts close-combat damage, they heal allies for 8% of their health within 3 cells or less around them (once per turn).

items.name: Helsephine's Love

items.description:
"You're right on time, as usual! Hurry up – I have exactly five minutes to spare. The Divine Clock waits for no one."

— Henual

effects.formatted:
Henual's Punctuality:
• When the bearer suffers an attempted AP or MP removal, they are teleported to their previous position up to one time for each type of removal.

items.name: Henual's Punctuality

items.description:
"We have travelled a long road together, but this victory belongs to you. The Twelve merely pointed you to the right path... We shall meet again soon, Gods' Chosen One. Your story has only just begun."

— Meriana

effects.formatted:
Meriana's Clairvoyance:
• When the bearer inflicts elemental damage, they gain Reduction based on the element for 2 turns (stackable 8 times, shared among effects):
 • Earth & Water: 5 MP Reduction
• Fire & Air: 5 AP Reduction

items.name: Meriana's Clairvoyance

items.description:
"When it comes to defending Bonta's values, all you need is a mind as sharp as a blade and a hardened body."

— Amayiro

effects.formatted:
Fervour of the White City:
• At the start of each turn, the bearer and their allies gain 1% Resistance for 1 turn for each enemy fighter alive (stackable 4 times).

items.name: Amayiro's Fervour

items.description: This is one heavy prysmaradite. It's quite remarkable for something so small. It reminds you of someone.

effects.formatted: The bearer is Unmovable as long as they have not suffered any damage. If they suffer damage, the duration of the state changes to 1 turn.

items.name: Unmovaprys

items.description: Just like Mastoslob, now you too can charge headlong at your enemies without fear of injury.
items.name: Mastoslob Headgear

items.description: Mastoslob's horn is extremely sharp. Wear with caution.
items.name: Mastoslob Amulet

items.description: This belt can definitely keep you warm, but the horns on it also make it very uncomfortable.
items.name: Mastoslob Belt

items.description: In his youth, Mister Penguin wasn't exactly the smoothest-sliding Pingwin on the ice. This chain has nothing to do with that, but hey, now you know.
items.name: Mister Penguin Chain

items.description: When you wear this belt, you'll look as chic as... well... a Pingwin wearing a belt.
items.name: Mister Penguin Belt

items.description: You'll absolutely flip for these fantastic flippers.
items.name: Mister Penguin Flippers

items.description: With this cape on, you too can be a tiger.
items.name: Katigger Cape

items.description: Some Frigostians like to slip these boots on to enjoy their morning bowl of Frosteez, for some reason.
items.name: Katigger Paws

items.description: Reminds you of a loathsome pain in the tail you once met on the Lonesome Pine Trails.
items.name: Katigger Glove

items.description: With this sail around your shoulders, you'll always have the wind at your back.
items.name: Pirate Bhey Sail

items.description: The little ghost-like element on this necklace constantly tries to communicate with its owner. If you hold it up close to your ear, you can hear it saying, "Booooouwu!"
items.name: Pirate Bhey Necklace

items.description: This bracelet may look unexceptional at first glance, but the little ghost who's wrapped up inside it is a real jack of all trades.
items.name: Pirate Bhey Bracelet

items.description: This mask may conceal your identity, but it won't protect you from the overwhelming stench of your own flatulence.
items.name: Masked Avenger Mask

items.description: This armband will prevent you from drowning in the Asse Sea.
items.name: Masked Avenger Armband

items.description: The Masked Avenger's shell is not only tough; it's also the perfect storage container for all the stuff she steals.
items.name: Masked Avenger Shell

items.description: This necklace is a perfect reflection of the terrifying creature that slumbers within you.
items.name: YeCh'Ti Collar

items.description: Bad guys should be careful, do you catch our drift?
items.name: YeCh'Ti Mitten

items.description: Defend your right to bear arms.
items.name: YeCh'Ti Arm

items.description: There's a simple engraving on this belt: "I was there". This helps San Jifu to keep her mind clear by always remembering where she comes from.
items.name: San Jifu Belt

items.description: San Jifu calls this ring "I am here" because it represents everything that has led her to this moment and everything that still remains to be discovered.
items.name: San Jifu Ring

items.description: Carved into the blade of this scythe are the words "There shall I be". For San Jifu, they symbolise not only her desire to achieve her dreams, but also the endpoint towards which all living beings are inexorably marching: death.
items.name: San Jifu Scythe

items.description: Ever since Flasho first appeared, red has become a symbol of speed for Frigostians. Since acquiring this ring, though, all that red symbolises for you is the state of your bank account.
items.name: Flasho Ring

items.description: Mow down your opponents as fast as lightning, leaving them thunderstruck.
items.name: Flaschythe

items.description: The blacksmith who forged this shield was clearly struck by a flash of inspiration.
items.name: Flasho's Flashy Shield

items.description: Doctor Gobotnegg once claimed to have seen a talking blue prespic roaming through the Snowy Forest. In other words, don't count on these goggles to fix your vision problems...
items.name: Doctor Gobotnegg Goggles

items.description: Caution: if you wear this ring, you could easily lose it through even the slightest injury.
items.name: Doctor Gobotnegg Golden Ring

items.description:
"Away with you, fool! Before I make mincemeat out of you!"

— Doctor Gobotnegg, always flailing about in sheer rage the moment you disturb him.
items.name: Doctor Gobotnegg Flail

items.description: A day without a honey pot is like a group of friends... without the friends.
items.name: Vinnie the Bearbarian Honey Pot

items.description: What could be better for those sudden hunger pangs than having a honey pot around your neck at all times?
items.name: Vinnie the Bearbarian Amulet

items.description: You notice a strange odour emanating from this slightly sticky loincloth. Looking a bit closer at the stains on it, you realise that they're not honey.
items.name: Vinnie the Bearbarian Loincloth

items.description: Much like the Ice Knight, you too will be clenching your fist inside this glove. Not because you're angry, but because your hand is actually frozen that way.
items.name: Ice Knight's Frozen Gauntlet

items.description: Some Frigostians use this blade to slice their morning sausage. Talk about brain freeze...
items.name: Ice Knight's Frozen Blade

items.description: This pavise is so bitterly cold that it can freeze your enemies solid... and you as well.
items.name: Ice Knight's Frigid Pavise

items.description: What does Erotegg have in common with the owners of this jewel? For one thing, they're all pretty broke now.
items.name: Erotegg Ring

items.description: When certain people won't stop squawking, you can always clip their wings with a well-aimed arrow.
items.name: Erotegg Bow

items.description: If you're the kind of person who wears your heart on your sleeve, now you can also wear it on your shield!
items.name: Erotegg Disc

items.description: This cape may make you look like a bee, but it won't make it any easier for you to find your honey.
items.name: Bearendizer Cape

items.description: Don't judge a bee by its cover.
items.name: Bearendizer Mace

items.description: Mess around and get stung. Repeatedly.
items.name: Bearendizer Shield

items.description: The cost of this ring is enough to drive you nuts.
items.name: Mekstagob Nut

items.description: Without this part, Mekstagob completely falls apart. At least... that's what we heard from a Frigostian kid whose uncle was supposedly a friend of Sylargh's.
items.name: Mekstagob Bolt

items.description: After a lifetime of clobbering enemies with this spade, you can also use it to dig your own grave.
items.name: Mekstagob Spade

items.description: Psychopump has sometimes been known to throw down the gloves with people he meets. Not all of them understand what that gesture means, though, so they just pick up the free gloves and go on their way.
items.name: Psychopump Glove

items.description: Finding this needle in a haystack wasn't all that hard after all. If only it was always this easy...
items.name: Psychopump Needle

items.description: This oversized button is perfect for hiding your oversized pimples.
items.name: Psychopump Button

items.description: If you love Osamodas and astrology, this ring is for you.
items.name: Osamoodring

items.description: This glove enables any good thief to remain dexterous and feel the smallest details of a lock without being thrown off by the fabric. As a bonus, your fingers will turn blue in winter, giving your outfit a touch of consistency.
items.name: Scalarcin Glove

items.description: These socks are toe-tally awesome.
items.name: Scalarcin Socks

items.description: To craft good daggeribones, you have to make them from a target that loves milk. Such an abundance of calcium makes these weapons extraordinarily durable.
items.name: Scalarcin Daggeribones

items.description: These ears are perfect for dressing up as a goblin.
items.name: Marzwel Ears

items.description: According to Marzwel, his bracelet gives you extraordinary agility. Actually, it just gives you normal agility.
items.name: Marzwel Bracelet

items.description: Crafted from Pandalan bamboo, this javelin is Marzwel's pride and joy. It's ideal for piercing passing adventurers or pole vaulting, so you won't get bored.
items.name: Marzwel Javelin

items.description: This helmet is thermoformed in a single size that is just a bit too small for your typical skull. It compresses the brain to prevent unnecessary thoughts, letting the wearer focus on what's essential – bashing others' heads in.
items.name: Qil Bil Helmet

items.description: They say that Qil Bil's wife was a Bworkette with an iron fist. As a symbol of their union, this ring clearly shows that she enjoyed turning the screw on him.
items.name: Qil Bil Ring

items.description: Force is always legitimate when used by someone wielding tonfas. At least, that's what tonfa manufacturers would have us believe.
items.name: Qil Bil Tonfas

items.description: An ideal piece of headgear for hiding in the mud and pouncing on unsuspecting prey. Just remember that the camouflage will wash off.
items.name: Tyranna Hood

items.description: If ever there was a tyrannical belt, it was this one.
items.name: Tyranna Belt

items.description: An iron fist in a croc glove.
items.name: Tyranna Glove

items.description: A rough upbringing and very little empathy – you're ready to pass all of that on to a child. But that's okay.
items.name: Scalptaras Ring

items.description: This apron, which once inspired confidence, was often accompanied by the delicious smell of homemade pastries. But ever since Aermyne became Braco, it has come to signify nothing more than the thwack of a rolling pin.
items.name: Scalptaras Apron

items.description: These boots are reinforced like safety shoes, so they won't get damaged during even the most intense butt-kicking sessions.
items.name: Scalptaras Boots

items.description: Make sure you pull this hood all the way over your head – dust can easily get in your eyes, and you'd just end up crying like a big baby again.
items.name: Musha Hood

items.description: The Musha veil – shame on whosoever wears it improperly.
items.name: Musha Veil

items.description: This is an eye-catching shield for sure.
items.name: Musha Sheyeld

items.description: If you have any twisted ideas, you might just end up behind bars.
items.name: Simbadas Cage

items.description: Sealing up a grille to use it as a shield is a far better idea than putting it around your neck... or anywhere else, for that matter.
items.name: Simbadas Barrier

items.description: You can always lend a helping paw to those in need.
items.name: Simbadas Paw

items.description: The golden tooth decorating this lucky charm necklace would make many an Enutrof jealous.
items.name: Rok Gnorok Lucky Charm

items.description: This hammer is a brilliant variant of the Ragnarok. It outshines it in every way.
items.name: The Rok Gnorok

items.description: What could be better than a big stone block to protect you?
items.name: Rok Gnorok Bastione

items.description: Any resemblance to the Alyverol hat is purely coincidental. Doesn't this thing have cute little ears?
items.name: Carlita Headband

items.description: A beautiful belt from Augerfeld, so you can be at the forefront of Sidimotian fashion.
items.name: Carlita Belt

items.description: If your sharpshooting skills leave a lot to be desired, you can always use this blunderbuss as a blunt weapon.
items.name: Carlita Blunderbuss

items.description: Like Naganita, you'll be all the talk of the town, with a wagging tongue and a tail to match. It's a cape worth telling tales about.
items.name: Naganita Cape

items.description: According to the Amakna militiamen, Naganita has been lucky time and time again because of her necklace, allowing her to escape justice without striking a blow. On the other hand, wearing this black jewel around your neck won't wipe out your alarming gambling debts. Everything has a price in life.
items.name: Naganita Necklace

items.description: Very difficult to wield but deadly when placed in the right hands, this unique weapon lets you strike a powerful blow and injure your opponent without fail, only to disappear afterwards.
items.name: Naganita Naginata

items.description: Watch out – it's spiky.
items.name: Spykhat

items.description: If you're looking for a hammer to destroy floors and walls alike, look no further – this one will let you hammer away at anything, punching holes in it as you go.
items.name: Spykhammer

items.description: What a sharp-looking shield!
items.name: Spykutcheon

items.description: You'll never need an umbrella while wearing this hat. It is completely waterproof.
items.name: War T Lily

items.description: With this lotus as a shield, you could consider becoming a flower, and a very beautiful one at that. Let's just hope you don't end your life in a vase, because that would be a rather sad final flourish.
items.name: War T Lotus

items.description: They say that this scythe sometimes gives off a sweet scent – so sweet that it puts everyone who inhales it to sleep forever more.
items.name: War T Scythe

items.description: The Transplents all have a tendency to tighten their belts, quite literally.
items.name: Transplent Belt

items.description: This shield seems to remind you of something else, which is perfectly normal. It's exactly what you're thinking.
items.name: Transplent Shield

items.description: The Transplents pass this sword down from generation to generation. Its blade might look like it's seen better days, but it's still sharp and penetrating.
items.name: Transplent Sword

items.description: Don't get your hopes up – this mask won't help you gain self-confidence.
items.name: Buddy Dubble Mask

items.description: You could fall over at the slightest misstep while wearing these getas.
items.name: Buddy Dubble Getas

items.description: Buddy Dubble never hesitates to draw his sword against those who make false judgements.
items.name: Buddy Dubble Sword

items.description: Some people with a very rhythmic way of speaking insist you shouldn't pause between the "Pti" and the "Doop". Just don't miss a beat when you're around them, and you'll get along great.
items.name: Ptidoop Cape

items.description: Supposedly, wearing this necklace scares animals away, especially turtles. Fortunately, if you like soup, they're rather easy to catch.
items.name: Ptidoop Collar

items.description: A ring adorned with a ring? Shushus are decidedly very eccentric creatures.
items.name: Ptidoop Ring

items.description: If you know someone who's big-headed, this wig should be perfect for them.
items.name: Predagob Wig

items.description: This bracelet smells of Predagob, but all his prey too, which is only natural because it's never been washed.
items.name: Predagob Bracelet

items.description: If you want to equip this loincloth in public, we suggest just going straight to the nearest prison.
items.name: Predagob Loincloth

items.description: If you ever get the idea of tying yourself up and poisoning yourself with an arrow from this bow, be under no illusions – it'll just kill you.
items.name: Karkanik Bow

items.description: This item is so large that it'd be difficult to grab you by the throat.
items.name: Potbellion Collar

items.description: If you don't fear shame, then equip this hat and act like a seemyool to your heart's content. Come to think of it, what sound does a seemyool make?
items.name: Seemyool Hat

items.description: Be it on land or at sea, you'll look great in these boots.
items.name: Seemyool Boots

items.description: Unfortunately, this cloak made from seemyool fins won't make you swim any faster.
items.name: Seemyool Cloak

items.description: If you're looking to keep a low profile, look elsewhere. These boots will make every step you take reverberate around you.
items.name: Rhineetle Boots

items.description: This cloak will make you feel like you've sprouted wings, but you'll still come crashing back to earth.
items.name: Rhineetle Cloak

items.description: This shield is useful in two ways – absorbing blows and impaling your opponents.
items.name: Rhineetle Shield

items.description: An old tale of Valonia recounts the adventures of a stubborn knight whose noggin was as hard as a rock. Is this the reason Belladonna used statues to guard her sanctuary, as a reference to this tale? Unless she just wanted her armoured henchman to be part of the decor... In any case, wearing a helm as massive as it is abrasive is the best way to go bald as a coot for good.
items.name: Sanctuary Guardian Helm

items.description: These metal leggings inspired by Ephedra's armour can be worn by anyone, even by people who suffer from heavy legs. In fact, these have been designed to stimulate the flow of blood, especially other people's. So, yeah, if you go around trampling all over the weak and defenceless, you might end up with a heavy conscience, but, then again maybe not, since you have to one to begin with.
items.name: Scarlet Greaves

items.description: Wear this pretty flower of evil around your neck, and it might just put you six feet under if you stay rooted to the spot doing nothing – no doubt some kind of trauma from its own childhood, being stuck in one place and all that. So make sure you run around like you usually do, or it'll stick you in the ground for good.
items.name: Vegegrip

items.description: The bearer of this headgear regularly inhales small doses of venom. This prolonged exposure gradually makes them naturally resistant to any kind of poison.
items.name: Moraympress Face

items.description: This lance is equipped with a pincer that lets you carve up the guts of the enemies you stab. As if a normal lance wasn't enough...
items.name: Crabinator Pincerlance

items.description: At the bottom of the chasm, it's so dark you can't even see yourself. This cape has a vibrating fin and emits sound waves, giving you echolocation, which is way more accurate than sight.
items.name: Willorka Dorsal Fin
